project.name: treetracker-android
project.description: Treetracker Android is Greenstand's native Android app for the Treetracker reforestation platform. Growers register tree captures (photos and GPS), manage grower accounts, and sync data to the Treetracker backend.

nodes.name: AgentTreeCapturer.kt
nodes.summary: Debug-build helper behind the agent-facing app functions that saves a requested number of trees with the bundled test image, skipping the camera, GPS convergence and review screens. It appends the trees to the capture session already running, or opens, fills and closes a one-off session for the chosen wallet, then refreshes the pending-sync count.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses withContext(NonCancellable) around session creation and inside a try/finally, so the temporary session always gets an id and is always closed even when the calling coroutine is cancelled.

nodes.name: AgentTreeCapturer
nodes.summary: Coordinates the DAO, UserRepo, SessionTracker, DeviceConfigUpdater, OrgRepo, CreateTreeUseCase and location sources so an automation agent can create realistic tree captures without the UI. Bad input surfaces as IllegalArgumentException messages written for the calling agent.

nodes.name: captureTrees
nodes.summary: Validates the tree count, picks a center from the given coordinates or the device location, and saves the trees into the running session (rejecting a different wallet) or into a new session for the wallet's account or the power user. It initializes device config and org first and returns an AgentCapturedTrees result with session id, wallet and tree UUIDs.

nodes.name: saveTrees
nodes.summary: Builds the requested Tree models with a shared session, note and a freshly copied test image, scatters each one around the center (or 0,0 without a center), seeds zero step-count attributes, and persists each through CreateTreeUseCase, returning the UUID strings.

nodes.name: spreadAround
nodes.summary: Picks a random point within TREE_SPREAD_MILES of the center with LocationUtils and normalizes it so latitude and longitude stay valid near a pole or the antimeridian.

nodes.name: deviceLocation
nodes.summary: Returns the current fix from LocationUpdateManager, or else the newest last-known Android location, as a latitude-longitude pair, or null when the app can see no location.

nodes.name: lastKnownLocation
nodes.summary: Checks the fine-location permission and, when it is granted, asks every enabled LocationManager provider for its last known fix and returns the most recent one.

nodes.name: Analytics.kt
nodes.summary: Firebase Analytics wrapper that tags the install with static device and build properties and exposes one method per tracked product event, such as tree planted, user check-in, note added, and sync or stop button taps.

nodes.name: Analytics
nodes.summary: Thin facade over FirebaseAnalytics, injected with DeviceUtils; its init block registers device user properties and its methods log named AnalyticEvents with small parameter bundles.

nodes.name: setupStaticDeviceProperties
nodes.summary: Runs from init to set Firebase user properties for device id, language, app version and build, manufacturer, brand, model, hardware, device, Android release and SDK level, with serial fixed to unknown.

nodes.name: tagScreen
nodes.summary: Logs a Firebase SCREEN_VIEW event with the given screen name and the activity's simple class name as the screen class.

nodes.name: uploadComplete
nodes.summary: Placeholder hook for an upload-complete event that accepts the number of trees on the device but currently logs nothing.

nodes.name: treePlanted
nodes.summary: Logs the TREE_PLANTED event with an empty parameter bundle each time a tree capture is saved.

nodes.name: userCheckedIn
nodes.summary: Logs the USER_CHECK_IN event, with no parameters, when a grower checks in to start capturing.

nodes.name: userInfoCreated
nodes.summary: Logs the USER_INFO_CREATED event with the new grower's email and phone strings in the bundle, called by UserRepo after an account insert.

nodes.name: userEnteredDetails
nodes.summary: Logs the USER_ENTERED_DETAILS event, with no parameters, at the grower details step of sign-up.

nodes.name: userEnteredEmailPhone
nodes.summary: Logs the USER_ENTERED_EMAIL_PHONE event, with no parameters, once the grower has typed an email or phone identifier.

nodes.name: treeNoteAdded
nodes.summary: Logs the NOTE_ADDED event with the character length of the note attached to a tree.

nodes.name: syncButtonTapped
nodes.summary: Logs SYNC_BUTTON_CLICKED with total, synced and unsynced tree counts, so sync usage can be compared with the upload backlog.

nodes.name: stopButtonTapped
nodes.summary: Logs STOP_BUTTON_CLICKED with the total, synced and unsynced tree counts at the moment the user stops a running sync.

nodes.name: markerClicked
nodes.summary: Logs MARKER_CLICKED with the latitude and longitude of the map marker the user tapped.

nodes.name: ExceptionDataCollector.kt
nodes.summary: Crashlytics context recorder that tracks the current and previous navigation route and sets custom keys (syncing state, wallets, session note, org, in-session flag), so crash reports show what the app was doing.

nodes.name: ExceptionDataCollector
nodes.summary: Wraps FirebaseCrashlytics with route tracking and typed key setters; its companion defines the shared key names, such as IS_SYNCING, USER_WALLET and IS_IN_SESSION, used across the app.

nodes.name: setScreen
nodes.summary: Records a navigation route change: when the route differs it shifts the old current route into lastRoute, then writes both routes as Crashlytics keys.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Writes a string custom key to Crashlytics, skipping null values, and also sets the Crashlytics user id when the key is the user or power-user wallet. A Boolean overload at lines 55-60 writes flags such as IS_SYNCING directly.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Blanks a Crashlytics custom key and, for the wallet keys, also resets the Crashlytics user id to an empty string.

nodes.name: NotificationConstants.kt
nodes.summary: Shared ids and channel names for the two notification sources of background sync: the progress notification of SyncNotificationManager and the foreground notification of TreeSyncWorker, plus the unique WorkManager job name.

nodes.name: NotificationConstants
nodes.summary: Kotlin object of compile-time constants for the sync and worker notification ids, channel ids and names, and the UNIQUE_WORK_ID used to enqueue the tree sync job.

nodes.name: TreeSyncWorker.kt
nodes.summary: WorkManager CoroutineWorker that runs the full data upload as a foreground data-sync job, shows live upload progress in a notification, and flags the sync in Crashlytics while it runs.
nodes.languageNotes: Gets its dependencies through Koin KoinComponent inject() delegates because WorkManager creates the worker by reflection; the progress poller is a child coroutine that the finally block cancels.

nodes.name: TreeSyncWorker
nodes.summary: CoroutineWorker and KoinComponent that injects SyncDataUseCase, SyncNotificationManager, the DAO and TreesToSyncHelper to run and report one tree upload pass.

nodes.name: doWork
nodes.summary: Promotes the work to foreground, then runs SyncDataUseCase while a sibling coroutine polls the DAO every 750 ms for images still pending and updates the progress notification with uploaded/total. It maps the use case result to success or failure and always resets the IS_SYNCING key.

nodes.name: getForegroundInfo
nodes.summary: Creates the high-importance worker channel on Android O and later, builds a silent ongoing upload notification that opens TreeTrackerActivity, and wraps it in ForegroundInfo with the data-sync service type on Android Q and later.

nodes.name: TreesToSyncHelper.kt
nodes.summary: Small cache of the number of tree images still waiting for upload: it recomputes the count from the legacy and v2 tree tables and stores it in Preferences, so the dashboard and the sync worker can read it cheaply.

nodes.name: TreesToSyncHelper
nodes.summary: Helper built on Preferences and the DAO, with TREES_TO_SYNC_KEY in the system-settings key space for the cached pending-upload count.

nodes.name: refreshTreeCountToSync
nodes.summary: Adds the legacy tree_capture rows and the v2 tree rows that still have no photo URL and commits the total to Preferences.

nodes.name: getTreeCountToSync
nodes.summary: Reads the cached pending-upload tree count from Preferences, returning -1 when it was never computed.

nodes.name: AppDatabase.kt
nodes.summary: Room database definition for the app's main SQLite store (schema version 9). It lists the legacy v1 entities and the v2 session, user, tree, location, device config and organization entities, declares the 7->8 and 8->9 auto migrations, and exposes every DAO plus a singleton factory.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines hand-written Migration objects for the old schemas (3 to 7) with Room AutoMigration for newer ones; exportSchema = true keeps JSON schema snapshots under app/schemas for migration tests.

nodes.name: AppDatabase
nodes.summary: Abstract RoomDatabase annotated with @Database and @TypeConverters(Converters), whose abstract accessors return each feature DAO and the aggregate TreeTrackerDAO.

nodes.name: treeDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that Room implements to hand out the TreeDAO for legacy tree captures and v2 trees.

nodes.name: userDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the UserDAO managing grower accounts in the user table.

nodes.name: sessionDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the SessionDAO for capture session rows.

nodes.name: organizationDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the OrganizationDAO for locally stored organization configs.

nodes.name: deviceConfigDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the DeviceConfigDAO for app and OS version snapshots.

nodes.name: planterDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the PlanterDAO for legacy planter_info and planter_check_in rows.

nodes.name: locationDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the LocationDAO for GPS rows in the location and location_data tables.

nodes.name: treeTrackerDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that returns the catch-all TreeTrackerDAO, which most repositories and use cases inject.

nodes.name: getInstance
nodes.summary: Builds the process-wide AppDatabase on the application context with the treetracker.v2.db file inside a synchronized block, then returns the cached instance. The null check sits outside the lock, so two concurrent first calls can each build a database.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Internal Room builder for a named database file with the four manual migrations added, shared by getInstance and by tests that open a database exactly as the app does.

nodes.name: Migrations.kt
nodes.summary: Hand-written Room migrations for the oldest schema versions: 3->4 rebuilds the original tables into planter_info, planter_check_in, tree_capture and tree_attribute and copies the data over, 4->5 adds a record UUID, 5->6 adds location_data, and 6->7 adds a photo path index.
nodes.languageNotes: Each migration is a top-level val holding an anonymous object : Migration(from, to); the SQL lives in Kotlin raw strings cleaned up with trimMargin or trimIndent.

nodes.name: MIGRATION_6_7
nodes.summary: Migration 6->7 that creates an index on planter_check_in.local_photo_path, which the queries for check-ins with photos still to upload filter on.

nodes.name: MIGRATION_5_6
nodes.summary: Migration 5->6 that, inside a transaction, creates the location_data table for JSON GPS records and an index on its uploaded flag.

nodes.name: MIGRATION_4_5
nodes.summary: Migration 4->5 that adds the non-null record_uuid column, defaulting to an empty string, to planter_info using the PlanterInfoEntity column constants.

nodes.name: MIGRATION_3_4
nodes.summary: Migration 3->4 that creates planter_info, planter_check_in, tree_capture and tree_attribute with their indexes, copies data from the 1.2.x tables (splitting the comma-separated location text into latitude and longitude and joining tree, photo, note and location rows), drops the old tables, and commits only if the integrity check passes.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerDAO.kt
nodes.summary: The aggregate Room DAO interface that most of the app injects: about ninety queries over the legacy planter and tree_capture tables and the v2 user, tree, session, location, device_config and organization tables, covering upload queues, bundle ids, upload flags, counts and Flow streams.
nodes.languageNotes: Room generates the implementation. The one default method, insertTreeWithAttributes, is a @Transaction so a capture and its attributes commit together. The feature DAOs in database/dao repeat subsets of these queries.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerDAO
nodes.summary: Room @Dao interface that bundles every query the app needs in one injectable type, from planter and user lookups to tree counts, location purges, session and device config upload bookkeeping, and organization storage.

nodes.name: getPlanterInfoIdByIdentifier

nodes.name: updateUser

nodes.name: getPlanterCheckInById

nodes.name: deletePlanterCheckIn

nodes.summary: Nulls local_photo_path on the given check-ins after their images are uploaded and the local files are no longer needed.

nodes.name: getTreeDataForMap

nodes.name: getUploadedTreeCaptureCount
nodes.summary: Counts legacy tree_capture rows whose uploaded flag is 1.

nodes.name: getUploadedLegacyTreeImageCount
nodes.summary: Counts legacy tree_capture rows that already have a photo_url, meaning the image reached the server.

nodes.name: getUploadedLegacyTreeImageCountFlow
nodes.summary: Flow version of the legacy uploaded-image count that updates live as photo URLs are written.

nodes.name: getUploadedTreeImageCount
nodes.summary: Counts v2 tree rows whose photo_url is set, the number of tree images already uploaded.

nodes.name: getUploadedTreeImageCountFlow
nodes.summary: Live Flow of the v2 uploaded tree image count for dashboard progress displays.

nodes.name: getUploadedTreeCount
nodes.summary: Counts v2 tree rows marked uploaded = 1, meaning the capture record itself was accepted.

nodes.name: getNonUploadedLegacyTreeCaptureImageCount

nodes.name: getNonUploadedLegacyTreeCaptureImageCountFlow
nodes.summary: Flow that emits the number of legacy tree captures whose image is still waiting for upload.

nodes.name: getNonUploadedTreeImageCount
nodes.summary: Counts v2 tree rows with a null photo_url, the other half of the pending-sync total used by TreesToSyncHelper and the sync worker.

nodes.name: getNonUploadedTreeImageCountFlow
nodes.summary: Flow of the number of v2 tree rows whose image has not been uploaded yet, for reactive sync indicators.

nodes.name: getNonUploadedTreeCaptureCount
nodes.summary: Transactional count of legacy tree_capture records with uploaded = 0.

nodes.name: getNonUploadedTreeCount

nodes.name: getAllTreeCaptureIdsToUpload
nodes.summary: Returns the ids of legacy tree captures still to upload, which the sync flow processes in batches.

nodes.name: getAllTreeIdsToUpload
nodes.summary: Returns the ids of v2 trees with uploaded = 0 so the tree uploader can fetch and send them.

nodes.name: getTreeCountFromSessionId
nodes.summary: Counts the v2 trees saved under one capture session, used to total a grower's trees.

nodes.name: getAllTreeCaptures

nodes.name: getTreeCaptureById
nodes.summary: Loads one legacy tree_capture by id; the non-null return type means Room throws when it is missing.

nodes.name: getTreeCapturesByIds
nodes.summary: Loads the legacy tree_capture rows for a batch of ids during upload.

nodes.name: getTreesByIds
nodes.summary: Loads the v2 tree rows for a batch of ids, the input to tree upload requests.

nodes.name: getTreesByUserWallet

nodes.name: deleteTreeById

nodes.name: updateTreesUploadStatus

nodes.name: removeTreesLocalImagePaths

nodes.name: updateTreeCapture

nodes.name: updateTree

nodes.name: deleteTreeCapture

nodes.name: getTreeAttributeByTreeCaptureId

nodes.name: insertTree

nodes.name: insertTreeWithAttributes
nodes.summary: Default @Transaction method that inserts a legacy tree capture, points each attribute at the new capture id, inserts the attributes, and returns the capture id, so the whole set commits atomically.

nodes.name: insertTreeCapture

nodes.name: insertTreeAttribute

nodes.name: getLocationData

nodes.name: getLocationsForTreeSessions

nodes.name: getSessionsToUpload

nodes.name: updateSessionBundleIds

nodes.name: updateSessionUploadStatus
nodes.summary: Sets the uploaded flag on a list of session ids.

nodes.name: getDeviceConfigsToUpload
nodes.summary: Returns the device_config snapshots not yet uploaded.

nodes.name: getDeviceConfigById

nodes.name: insertDeviceConfig

nodes.name: updateDeviceConfigBundleIds
nodes.summary: Writes the upload bundle id onto a batch of device_config rows.

nodes.summary: Sets the uploaded flag on a list of device_config ids.

nodes.summary: Returns the most recently logged device_config row by logged_at, which new sessions reference.

nodes.name: insertOrg

nodes.name: DeviceConfigDAO.kt
nodes.summary: Focused Room DAO for the device_config table: the upload queue, lookup by id, insert, bundle id and upload flag updates, and the latest snapshot.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigDAO
nodes.summary: Room @Dao interface with six device_config queries that mirror the device config part of TreeTrackerDAO; AppDatabase exposes it through deviceConfigDao().

nodes.name: DeviceConfigEntity.kt

nodes.name: DeviceConfigEntity

nodes.name: LocationEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Room entity for the v2 location table, which stores GPS fixes as JSON text tied to a capture session.

nodes.name: LocationEntity
nodes.summary: Data class mapped to location with a cascading foreign key to session, indexed session_id and uploaded columns, and a creation timestamp that defaults to the current time (column name create_at).

nodes.name: OrganizationEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Room entity for the organization table that caches an org link: id, version, name, wallet, and the JSON definitions of its capture setup flow and capture flow.

nodes.name: OrganizationEntity
nodes.summary: Data class keyed by a string _id that persists an organization's configuration, including the capture_setup_flow_json and capture_flow_json that drive the configurable capture screens.

nodes.name: SessionEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Room entity for the session table, the v2 record of one capture session with origin and destination wallets, start and end times, organization, note, device config link and upload state.

nodes.name: SessionEntity
nodes.summary: Data class mapped to session with an indexed origin_wallet and a cascading foreign key to device_config; end_time stays null until the session is closed.

nodes.name: TreeEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Room entity for the v2 tree table: one captured tree with its session link, local photo path and remote URL, note, coordinates, creation time, upload state and extra attributes.

nodes.name: TreeEntity
nodes.summary: Data class mapped to tree with a cascading foreign key to session, indexed session_id and uploaded columns, and an extra_attributes map stored through the database type converters.

nodes.name: UserEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Room entity for the user table, the v2 grower account with wallet, names, contact fields, registration location, photo path and URL, upload state and power-user flag.

nodes.name: UserEntity
nodes.summary: Data class mapped to user with an indexed wallet column and a power_user flag, defaulting to 0, that marks the device administrator account.

nodes.name: LocationDataEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy Room entity for the location_data table, which holds JSON GPS records from the 1.x location capture with an upload flag and creation time.

nodes.name: LocationDataEntity
nodes.summary: Data class whose table and column names come from companion constants; the uploaded column is indexed so upload queries and purges stay fast.

nodes.name: PlanterCheckInEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy Room entity for planter_check_in, the v1 record of a planter checking in with a photo path or URL and coordinates.

nodes.name: PlanterCheckInEntity
nodes.summary: Data class with a cascading foreign key to planter_info, indexed planter_info_id and local_photo_path columns, and companion constants for its table and column names.

nodes.name: PlanterInfoEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy Room entity for planter_info, the v1 grower registration with identifier, names, organization, contact fields, location, upload state, bundle id and record UUID.

nodes.name: PlanterInfoEntity
nodes.summary: Data class whose companion constants supply the table and column names; Migrations reuses them to add the record_uuid column in the 4 to 5 migration.

nodes.name: TreeAttributeEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy Room entity for tree_attribute, the key-value extras attached to a v1 tree capture.

nodes.name: TreeAttributeEntity
nodes.summary: Data class with a cascading foreign key to tree_capture through an indexed tree_capture_id, which insertTreeWithAttributes fills in after it inserts the capture.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureEntity.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy Room entity for tree_capture, the v1 tree record with UUID, check-in link, photo path and URL, note, coordinates, accuracy, upload state and bundle id.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureEntity
nodes.summary: Data class with a cascading foreign key to planter_check_in and companion constants for its columns; the check-in column is spelled planter_checkin_id in the schema.

nodes.name: TreeMapMarkerDbView.kt
nodes.summary: Plain projection class for the map query, which selects only the latitude, longitude and tree capture id from legacy tree_capture.

nodes.name: TreeMapMarkerDbView
nodes.summary: Lightweight holder with three read-only properties that Room fills from getTreeDataForMap, so map markers avoid full entity loads.

nodes.name: RoomModule.kt
nodes.summary: Koin module that registers the Room databases as singletons: AppDatabase with each of its DAOs, and the separate MessageDatabase with its MessagesDAO.

nodes.name: roomModule
nodes.summary: Top-level Koin module value with eleven single definitions that resolve AppDatabase.getInstance and its eight DAO accessors, plus MessageDatabase and its messagesDao(), from the Android context.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigUpdater.kt
nodes.summary: Keeps the device_config table current: at startup it compares the latest stored snapshot with the running app version, build, OS release and SDK level, and records a new snapshot when any of them differ.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigUpdater
nodes.summary: Service built on the DAO and TimeProvider that makes sure a current device configuration row exists for new sessions to reference.

nodes.name: saveLatestConfig
nodes.summary: Loads the newest device_config, creating one when none exists, and saves a fresh snapshot when the build or OS values no longer match the running app.

nodes.name: saveNewDeviceConfig
nodes.summary: Builds a DeviceConfigEntity with a random UUID, the BuildConfig version name and code, the Android release and SDK level and the current time, inserts it, and returns it.

nodes.name: SessionTracker.kt
nodes.summary: Owns the lifecycle of capture sessions: it starts the current session from capture setup data, creates and closes standalone sessions, ends the current one, and restores a session that was running when Android killed the app, while it mirrors session context into Crashlytics keys.

nodes.name: SessionTracker
nodes.summary: Stateful service that keeps the current session id in memory and in Preferences under SESSION_ID_KEY, built on the DAO, OrgRepo, TimeProvider, TreesToSyncHelper and ExceptionDataCollector.

nodes.name: startSession
nodes.summary: Ends any running session, creates a new one from the CaptureSetupScopeManager data (user, organization, note), makes it current, saves its id to Preferences, and records the org, wallets, note and in-session state in Crashlytics.

nodes.name: createSession
nodes.summary: On the IO dispatcher, loads the user and inserts a SessionEntity with a new UUID, the user's wallet as origin and destination, the given or current org name, the latest device config id and the note, without making it current.

nodes.name: closeSession
nodes.summary: Sets end_time on one session to the current time and saves it, leaving the current session pointer untouched.

nodes.name: endSession
nodes.summary: Closes the current session if there is one, clears the in-memory and stored session id, refreshes the pending-sync tree count, and clears the session-related Crashlytics keys.

nodes.name: resumeInterruptedSession
nodes.summary: Makes the session id saved in Preferences current again after process death, so a restored capture flow keeps adding trees to it; returns false when no session was running.

nodes.name: wasSessionInterrupted
nodes.summary: Reports whether no session is current in memory while Preferences still records an active session id, which means the app was killed mid-session.

nodes.name: Tree.kt
nodes.summary: Parcelable domain model for a tree being captured, which carries the UUID, session, note, photo path, mean coordinates and a mutable attribute map, plus the attribute key names saved with each capture.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares a named companion object (Attributes) instead of the default Companion, so callers write Tree.ABS_STEP_COUNT_KEY while the object itself has a descriptive name.

nodes.name: Tree
nodes.summary: @Parcelize data class that carries a tree capture between screens and into CreateTreeUseCase; its private attribute map is filled through addTreeAttribute.

nodes.name: addTreeAttribute
nodes.summary: Puts or overwrites one key-value attribute, such as a step count or height color, on the tree.

nodes.name: treeCaptureAttributes
nodes.summary: Exposes the tree's collected attributes as a read-only Map for persistence.

nodes.name: Attributes
nodes.summary: Named companion object that lists the attribute keys stored with a tree: height color, app build, flavor and version, absolute and delta step counts, rotation matrix, and DBH (diameter at breast height).

nodes.name: LocationUpdateManager.kt
nodes.summary: Wraps Android LocationManager GPS updates for the app: it requests or removes updates with intervals from ConvergenceConfiguration, keeps the latest fix, and publishes fixes through LiveData.

nodes.name: LocationUpdateManager
nodes.summary: Location service that exposes locationUpdateLiveData, isUpdating and currentLocation, and checks location permission before any GPS request.

nodes.name: locationUpdateListener
nodes.summary: Anonymous LocationListener held in a property that saves each new fix as currentLocation, posts it to the LiveData, and logs provider status changes.

nodes.name: startLocationUpdates
nodes.summary: Requests GPS updates with the configured minimum time and distance when location permission is held and updates are not already running, catching the SecurityException older Android throws for approximate-only permission; returns whether updates are active.

nodes.name: stopLocationUpdates
nodes.summary: Stops GPS updates only when nothing observes the LiveData, then removes the listener, posts null and clears isUpdating; returns whether the stop was honored.

nodes.name: refreshLocationUpdateRequest
nodes.summary: Re-registers the GPS listener with the current ConvergenceConfiguration intervals so changed timing settings take effect.

nodes.name: hasLocationPermissions
nodes.summary: Returns true when either the fine or the coarse location permission is granted.

nodes.name: OrgConfigProvider.kt
nodes.summary: Fetches an organization's configuration JSON from Firebase Remote Config under the key org_<orgId>, with a 10 second timeout and logging under the OrgLink tag.

nodes.name: OrgConfigProvider
nodes.summary: Provider that wraps FirebaseRemoteConfig; its single method turns an org id into the org's config JSON or null.

nodes.name: fetchOrgConfig
nodes.summary: Runs fetchAndActivate under a 10 s timeout, then reads the org_ prefixed key and returns its value; returns null on a timeout, a blank value or any exception, and logs the elapsed time in each case.

nodes.name: UserRepo.kt
nodes.summary: Repository for grower accounts that maps user rows to User models (with tree totals and unread-message flags) and handles account creation, lookup, power-user status, deletion and profile updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Declares package org.greenstand.android.TreeTracker.models although the file lives in models/user, and overloads createUser: the public one inserts a new account and the private one maps a UserEntity to a User.

nodes.name: UserRepo
nodes.summary: Repository that combines TreeTrackerDAO, MessagesDAO, LocationUpdateManager, Analytics, TimeProvider and ExceptionDataCollector; its private createUser(UserEntity) overload (lines 116-136) sums tree counts over the user's sessions and checks unread messages to build each User.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Flow of User models built from the DAO user stream, dropping rows that fail to map.

nodes.name: getUserList
nodes.summary: Suspend snapshot of all accounts mapped to User models.

nodes.name: getUser
nodes.summary: Loads one account by id as a User model, or null when the id is unknown.

nodes.name: getUserWithWallet
nodes.summary: Loads the account for a wallet as a User, or null when no account uses that wallet.

nodes.name: deleteUser
nodes.summary: Deletes the account rows for a wallet and reports whether any row was removed.

nodes.name: checkForUnreadMessagesPerUser
nodes.summary: Returns true when MessagesDAO counts at least one unread message for the wallet.

nodes.name: getPowerUser
nodes.summary: Returns the device's power user as a User model, or null when no account has the flag.

nodes.name: setPowerUserStatus
nodes.summary: Updates a user's power-user flag but grants it only when no power user exists yet, so the device keeps a single administrator.

nodes.name: createUser
nodes.summary: On the IO dispatcher, inserts a new UserEntity with the current location (or 0,0), timestamp, random UUID and photo path, tags Crashlytics with the wallet for a power user, logs the analytics user-created event, and returns the new id. A private overload maps entities to User models.

nodes.name: doesUserExists
nodes.summary: Checks whether an account exists for the given wallet identifier.

nodes.name: updateUser
nodes.summary: Copies an edited User's names and photo path onto its stored row, clears the photo URL when the photo changed, resets uploaded so the registration is sent again, and keeps the registered phone and email.

nodes.name: ScreenTrackingNavEntryDecorator.kt
nodes.summary: Navigation 3 entry decorator module: defines the shared 300 ms fade transitions, the LocalNavEntryContentKey composition local, and a composable that wraps every NavDisplay entry with Crashlytics screen tracking and a per-entry scoped Navigator for double-tap protection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a Navigation 3 NavEntryDecorator with CompositionLocalProvider to re-provide LocalNavigator per entry; a LaunchedEffect keyed on the screen name reports each screen once.

nodes.name: rememberScreenTrackingNavEntryDecorator
nodes.summary: Composable that remembers a NavEntryDecorator which reports the route name (contentKey text before the first parenthesis) to ExceptionDataCollector.setScreen, and re-provides LocalNavEntryContentKey and an entry-scoped LocalNavigator around the entry content.

nodes.name: SplashScreenViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: Splash screen state holder that bootstraps the app at launch: it saves the device config, resolves an org link from a deeplink or the Play install referrer, applies remote or minimal org config, syncs messages when online, tags crash reports with the power user wallet, and refreshes the pending tree count.

nodes.name: SplashState
nodes.summary: Immutable splash UI state with a single isBootstrapping flag that defaults to true while startup work runs.

nodes.name: SplashAction
nodes.summary: Sealed action set for the splash screen; its only member StartGPSUpdatesForSignup asks the view model to begin GPS updates before the signup flow.

nodes.name: SplashScreenViewModel
nodes.summary: BaseViewModel subclass that takes the deeplink orgId and orgName plus eleven injected collaborators, starts GPS on request, runs the bootstrap sequence, and reports whether initial setup is needed because no power user exists.

nodes.name: bootstrap
nodes.summary: Suspend startup routine: saves the latest device config, ensures OrgRepo is loaded, adds the linked org from fetched remote config or as a minimal default org, syncs messages if a ping succeeds, records the power user wallet for crash reports, and refreshes the tree-to-sync count on IO after an interrupted session or a missing count.

nodes.name: linkedOrg
nodes.summary: Private resolver that returns an OrgLink from a non-blank deeplink orgId, otherwise falls back to consuming the org saved from the Play install referrer.

nodes.name: SplashScreenViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider.Factory that passes the deeplink org id and name into SplashScreenViewModel and resolves the other eleven constructor dependencies from Koin.

nodes.name: TreeDetailViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State and actions for the tree detail screen of the tree edit feature: loads one saved tree by id, lets the grower edit and save its note, and deletes the tree with its local photo after a confirmation dialog.

nodes.name: TreeDetailState
nodes.summary: Detail screen state holding the loaded TreeEntity, the note text being edited, and whether the delete confirmation dialog is visible.

nodes.name: TreeDetailAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of tree detail intents: UpdateNote, SaveNote, DeleteTree, SetDeleteDialogVisibility, and NavigateBack.

nodes.name: TreeDetailViewModel
nodes.summary: BaseViewModel for one tree id that loads the TreeEntity through TreeTrackerDAO.getTreesByIds in its init block and exposes note editing and deletion through handleAction.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Dispatches tree detail actions: updates the draft note, saves it with dao.updateTree and a saved snackbar, deletes the photo file and the tree row then refreshes the tree-to-sync count and pops back, toggles the delete dialog, or navigates back.

nodes.name: TreeDetailViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: Factory that builds TreeDetailViewModel for a given tree id and pulls TreeTrackerDAO and TreesToSyncHelper from Koin.

nodes.name: TreeListViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State holder for the tree list screen: observes all trees captured under a user wallet from Room and tracks which tree is selected, keeping the selection in step with fresh query results.

nodes.name: TreeListState
nodes.summary: Tree list UI state with the wallet's TreeEntity list, the selected tree, and an isLoading flag that clears after the first emission.

nodes.name: TreeListAction
nodes.summary: Sealed tree list action type whose single SelectTree member carries the TreeEntity the user tapped.

nodes.name: TreeListViewModel
nodes.summary: BaseViewModel that collects dao.getTreesByUserWallet in its init block, replaces the selected tree with its refreshed copy (or clears it when the tree is gone), and handles SelectTree by storing the tapped tree.

nodes.name: TreeListViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: Factory that creates TreeListViewModel for a wallet string and resolves TreeTrackerDAO through Koin.

nodes.name: CheckForInternetUseCase.kt
nodes.summary: Small use case that reports whether the device can reach the internet, used to gate message sync on the splash and dashboard screens.

nodes.name: CheckForInternetUseCase
nodes.summary: UseCase<Unit, Boolean> subclass that tells callers such as the splash and dashboard view models whether the network is reachable before they sync messages.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Runs a single ping to google.com on Dispatchers.IO through Runtime.exec and returns true only for exit code 0, treating any exception as offline.

nodes.name: CreateFakeTreesUseCase.kt
nodes.summary: Debug and beta only use case that seeds the local database with fake captures: half the requested amount as new-schema trees and half as legacy planter check-ins and tree captures for two test planters, all with test images and random nearby locations.

nodes.name: CreateFakeTreesParams
nodes.summary: Parameter object for CreateFakeTreesUseCase holding the total number of fake trees to generate.

nodes.name: CreateFakeTreesUseCase
nodes.summary: UseCase that combines SessionTracker, LocationUpdateManager, TimeProvider, ImageUtils and the two tree creation use cases to fabricate realistic local capture data for developers.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Guards on FeatureFlags.DEBUG_ENABLED or BETA, creates amount/2+1 new trees with fixed DBH, step count and rotation attributes, then builds two legacy planters who check in and plant legacy trees in an interleaved sequence.

nodes.name: createLegacyUser
nodes.summary: Inserts a PlanterInfoEntity with the given name, organization and contact details at the current location and time on Dispatchers.IO, then reads it back by id.

nodes.name: createLegacyCheckIn
nodes.summary: Stores a PlanterCheckInEntity for a planter with a copied test image and a random location within one mile of the current position.

nodes.name: createLegacyTree
nodes.summary: Builds a Tree with a test photo and random nearby coordinates in the current session and hands it to CreateLegacyTreeUseCase; it passes the planter info id in the slot the params name planterCheckInId.

nodes.name: CreateLegacyTreeUseCase.kt
nodes.summary: Use case that writes a capture into the legacy tree_capture schema, mapping a Tree model to a TreeCaptureEntity plus TreeAttributeEntity rows for the older bulk upload path.

nodes.name: CreateLegacyTreeParams
nodes.summary: Input pair for legacy tree creation: the planter check-in id the capture belongs to and the Tree model to persist.

nodes.name: CreateLegacyTreeUseCase
nodes.summary: UseCase<CreateLegacyTreeParams, Long> backed by TreeTrackerDAO and TimeProvider that returns the row id of the inserted legacy capture.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: On Dispatchers.IO, builds a TreeCaptureEntity with zero accuracy and a creation time in epoch seconds (the legacy bulk pack format), converts the tree's capture attributes to attribute entities, and inserts both in one DAO call.

nodes.name: CreateTreeUseCase.kt
nodes.summary: Primary use case that persists a newly captured tree into the current tree table and records a tree planted analytics event.

nodes.name: CreateTreeUseCase
nodes.summary: UseCase<Tree, Long> that depends on TreeTrackerDAO, Analytics and TimeProvider and returns the generated tree row id.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Maps a Tree to a TreeEntity with session id, photo path, note, mean coordinates, location-based creation time and extra attributes, fires analytics.treePlanted, and inserts the row on Dispatchers.IO.

nodes.name: ImageUtils.kt
nodes.summary: Large image utility object for capture photos: creates private JPEG files, decodes and rotates bitmaps from EXIF data, resizes and recompresses files in place, encodes Base64 uploads, and implements grayscale conversion, Gaussian blur and Brenner focus scoring for blur detection.
nodes.languageNotes: Kotlin object singleton; several functions use two-pass decoding (inJustDecodeBounds, then inSampleSize) and the deprecated BitmapFactory.Options.inPurgeable flag to limit memory use.

nodes.name: ImageUtils
nodes.summary: Stateless Kotlin object that groups all bitmap file, orientation, encoding and focus metric helpers used by the camera, the capture flow and the debug seeding code.

nodes.name: createTestImageFile
nodes.summary: Copies a bundled asset (testtreeimage.jpg by default) into a new private image file so debug code and tests have a real JPEG to attach to fake captures.

nodes.name: createImageFile
nodes.summary: Creates an empty temp file named IMG_<timestamp>_*.jpg inside the app-private treeImages directory for the camera to write into.

nodes.name: decodeBitmap
nodes.summary: Decodes a photo sampled down to about 500 dp width in RGB_565, reads the EXIF orientation, and returns a bitmap rotated by 90, 180 or 270 degrees so it displays upright, or null if decoding fails.

nodes.name: printImage
nodes.summary: Debug helper that prints a two-dimensional pixel grid to standard output row by row with a running row counter.

nodes.name: printImage
nodes.summary: Overload that prints a flat pixel array as rows and columns to standard output; its index expression (r * cols) + cols reads one row ahead of the intended pixel.

nodes.name: getGrayPixelFromBitmap
nodes.summary: Loads an image sampled to a target width in ARGB_8888, copies its pixels into a 2D grid, and returns the grayscale grid used as input for focus measurement, or null if decoding fails.

nodes.name: generateRandomBlurredImage
nodes.summary: Test aid that blurs a grayscale grid with a Gaussian kernel of random width from 1 to 9, or returns it unchanged when the random value is 0, to exercise focus detection.

nodes.name: getGrayPixels
nodes.summary: Private converter that turns packed RGB pixels into luminance values with the 0.299, 0.587 and 0.114 channel weights.

nodes.name: gaussian
nodes.summary: Builds a square Gaussian kernel of the given width and sigma and returns it together with the sum of its weights for normalization.

nodes.name: performCorrelation

nodes.summary: Validates the given names and contact, then under the shared creation lock rejects an existing wallet, decides whether the new user becomes the power user, saves the account with the test selfie, and returns an AgentAccount summary.
