nodes.summary: Debug-only validation object that checks and normalizes the arguments agents pass to the app's AppFunctions, with the same name, phone, email, tree count and coordinate rules as the sign-up and capture screens. Bad input throws IllegalArgumentException with an agent-readable message.

nodes.name: AgentInput
nodes.summary: Singleton that holds the AppFunctions input rules: default test names, a 500-tree cap, and helpers that validate account details, tree counts and coordinates before any data is written.

nodes.name: AccountDetails
nodes.summary: Nested data class that holds the trimmed, validated createAccount input, with at most one of phone or email set and the email already lowercased.

nodes.name: accountDetails
nodes.summary: Turns raw agent arguments into AccountDetails: rejects a phone and an email together, defaults missing names to Test User, validates names and phone digits, and lowercases an email that must contain an @.

nodes.name: walletLookups
nodes.summary: Returns the distinct wallet strings to search for an account: the trimmed input and its lowercased form, because email wallets are saved lowercased.

nodes.name: requireTreeCount
nodes.summary: Guards the number of trees an agent asks to capture, and throws unless the count lies between 1 and the 500-tree maximum.

nodes.name: treeCenter
nodes.summary: Validates an optional latitude and longitude pair, requiring both or neither and in-range values, and returns the point to scatter trees around or null.

nodes.name: normalizeCoordinates
nodes.summary: Brings a computed point back into valid range: it clamps latitude to plus or minus 90 and wraps longitude into the minus 180 to 180 interval, for trees spread near a pole or the antimeridian.

nodes.name: requireValidName
nodes.summary: Runs ValidationUtils.validateName on one name field and throws an IllegalArgumentException that names the field and the validation error when it fails.

nodes.name: E2eActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Debug-only activity that end-to-end tests open through treetracker-e2e links. The setup link seeds an admin account and two trees and writes a result file; the dashboard, dev-options and capture links render the real Root with a prepared back stack.

nodes.name: E2eActivity
nodes.summary: AppCompatActivity that accepts only known treetracker-e2e hosts, runs fixture setup or prepares app state through Koin, and then shows CustomTheme and Root with an initial back stack that the test chooses.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Parses the E2E link and either creates the seed account and trees on the IO dispatcher and records ready or an error in a file, or initializes the org, device config and power-user check before it composes Root with dashboard, dev-options or capture routes.

nodes.name: captureBackStack
nodes.summary: Prepares a capture session the way capture setup does: it briefly opens the setup scope with the power user and org, sets the user ID, starts the session, step counter, orientation and GPS, then returns a Dashboard plus TreeCapture back stack.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerActivity.kt
nodes.summary: The app's single launcher activity: it enables edge-to-edge with dark scrims, parses the start route from the launch intent, and composes Root inside CustomTheme, or a no-GPS dialog when the device has no GPS provider.
nodes.languageNotes: It plants the navigation-event dispatcher owner on the decor view by hand, because AppCompatActivity's setContentView does not, and the Navigation 3 NavDisplay needs it for back handling.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerActivity
nodes.summary: Main AppCompatActivity that injects the shared view model factory and GpsUtils through Koin and hosts the whole Compose UI tree.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Configures system bar scrims, reads the deep-link start route, sets the Compose content to Root or NoGPSDeviceDialog depending on GPS hardware, and installs the navigation-event dispatcher owner for Navigation 3 back handling.

nodes.name: SyncNotificationManager.kt
nodes.summary: Builds and updates the foreground notification shown while the tree sync worker uploads data, including the sync notification channel on Android O and later and the data-sync foreground service type on Android Q and later.

nodes.name: SyncNotificationManager
nodes.summary: Wraps NotificationManagerCompat to give the sync worker a ForegroundInfo at start and progress updates afterwards, and remembers the application context between calls.

nodes.name: createForegroundInfo
nodes.summary: Stores the context, creates the channel when needed, and returns a ForegroundInfo with an indeterminate low-priority Syncing notification, typed as a data-sync foreground service on API 29 and above.

nodes.name: updateProgress
nodes.summary: Reposts the sync notification with a determinate progress bar and custom text that alerts only once; it does nothing if createForegroundInfo has not supplied a context yet.

nodes.name: createNotificationChannel
nodes.summary: Registers the sync notification channel with default importance and its description; it is annotated for API 26 because NotificationChannel does not exist earlier.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the tree photo review step of the capture flow: the grower sees the photo, can add a note, and moves forward or back, with a forced-note rule that the org's FORCE_NOTE feature controls.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewState
nodes.summary: Immutable UI state for image review that holds the photo path, the note draft, whether the note dialog is open, and whether to show the first-tree review tutorial.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of image review intents: update or add the note, toggle the tutorial or note dialog, try to navigate forward, or go back.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewViewModel
nodes.summary: Drives image review: it reads the force-note flag for this route, returns to the dashboard if a process-death restore lost the tree, shows the tutorial only on a grower's first tree, and saves notes through TreeCapturer.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Reduces image review actions: updates the note or dialog state, blocks forward navigation with a dialog when a note is forced but blank, persists the note on AddNote, and sends capture-flow navigation events.

nodes.name: isFirstTrack
nodes.summary: Returns true when the power user has captured no trees yet, or when no power user exists, so the review tutorial shows on the first capture.

nodes.name: DashboardViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel behind the home dashboard: it observes synced and pending tree counts from Room, starts or cancels the unique WorkManager tree sync, reports sync state through snackbars, and checks for unread messages and multiple orgs.
nodes.languageNotes: The syncing flag uses Delegates.observable, so setting it back to false automatically refreshes the non-tree dashboard data.

nodes.name: DashboardState
nodes.summary: Dashboard UI state with synced, remaining and total tree counts, org button and unread-message flags, and a sync reminder flag; it derives uploadProgress from remaining over total.

nodes.name: DashboardAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of dashboard intents: sync trees, sync messages, open org, capture, messages or settings, and confirm the sync reminder dialog.

nodes.name: DashboardViewModel
nodes.summary: Coordinates dashboard data and sync: it stops GPS on entry, maps WorkManager states of the unique sync job to snackbar messages, keeps tree counts current, and records sync and stop taps in analytics.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Routes dashboard actions to message sync or the tree sync toggle; the screen handles the navigation actions itself.

nodes.name: syncMessages
nodes.summary: Launches a coroutine that syncs messages with the backend only when the internet check succeeds.

nodes.name: toggleSync
nodes.summary: Starts tree sync when idle (showing a nothing-to-sync snackbar when no trees remain, unless debug mode is on) or cancels the running unique work, and logs the matching analytics event with the current counts.

nodes.name: observeTreeCounts
nodes.summary: Combines four DAO flows of uploaded and pending legacy and new tree images into synced and remaining counts, keeps the total fixed during a sync, and raises the reminder dialog at 2000 or more pending trees.

nodes.name: updateNonTreeData
nodes.summary: On the IO dispatcher, checks whether more than one org exists and whether unread messages are waiting, then publishes both flags to the dashboard state on the main thread.

nodes.name: startDataSynchronization
nodes.summary: Enqueues an expedited one-time TreeSyncWorker request with linear backoff as unique work, and keeps any sync that is already queued.

nodes.name: onCleared
nodes.summary: Removes the forever observer from the unique sync work LiveData when the dashboard ViewModel is cleared, so the observer does not leak.

nodes.name: Configurator.kt
nodes.summary: Typed persistence for developer option values: it reads and writes BooleanConfig, IntConfig and FloatConfig entries in the app Preferences, with generic getValue and putValue dispatchers that the dev options screen uses.

nodes.name: Configurator
nodes.summary: Thin facade over Preferences that stores each developer config under its key and falls back to the config's default value on read.

nodes.name: getBoolean
nodes.summary: Reads a boolean developer setting from Preferences and falls back to the BooleanConfig default.

nodes.name: putBoolean
nodes.summary: Saves a boolean developer setting under its config key with an asynchronous Preferences edit.

nodes.name: getInt
nodes.summary: Reads an integer developer setting, such as a GPS convergence timeout, and uses the IntConfig default when it is unset.

nodes.name: putInt
nodes.summary: Persists an integer developer setting under its IntConfig key through an apply() edit.

nodes.name: getFloat
nodes.summary: Reads a float developer setting, such as a coordinate standard-deviation threshold, and uses the FloatConfig default when it is unset.

nodes.name: putFloat
nodes.summary: Persists a float developer setting under its FloatConfig key through an apply() edit.

nodes.name: putValue
nodes.summary: Writes an untyped value: it matches the value as Boolean, Int or Float and calls the typed setter with the config cast to the matching type.

nodes.name: getValue
nodes.summary: Reads any developer config by an exhaustive match on its sealed type that calls the typed getter.

nodes.name: DevOptionsViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the debug developer options screen: it edits stored config values and manages org link overrides that turn setup and capture steps, features and the wallet ID on or off over what the current org configures.

nodes.name: DevOptionsState
nodes.summary: Dev options UI state that holds the editable config parameters and the org link override section, which is null when no current org exists.

nodes.name: OrgSettingRow
nodes.summary: One row in the org override editor that pairs the org's default with an optional override; required rows ignore overrides, and the row derives the effective value and an isOverridden flag.

nodes.name: OrgLinkOverridesState
nodes.summary: Snapshot of the org override section: org identity, master switch, setup, capture and feature rows, the wallet ID and its override, and the effective step labels of both flows.

nodes.name: DevOptionsAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of dev options intents: update a config param, go back, toggle overrides, override a step, a feature or the wallet ID, and reset all overrides.

nodes.name: DevOptionsViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads current config values through Configurator, builds the org override view from OrgRepo and OrgOverrideStore, applies edits, and refreshes the GPS convergence configuration when the screen closes.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Maps each dev options action to a config update, back navigation, or a transform of the stored org overrides, and clears the store on reset.

nodes.name: updateOrgOverrides
nodes.summary: Applies a transform to the OrgOverrideStore and rebuilds the org link section of the state.

nodes.name: buildOrgLinkState
nodes.summary: Builds OrgLinkOverridesState from the base current org and the stored overrides, including effective flow labels, or returns null with a warning when no org is initialized.

nodes.name: stepRows
nodes.summary: Creates one OrgSettingRow per catalog step of a flow, marks whether the org's normalized routes include that step, and attaches any stored step override.

nodes.name: featureRows
nodes.summary: Creates OrgSettingRows for catalog features by checking whether the org's matching destination lists the feature key, and attaches stored feature overrides.

nodes.name: stepLabel
nodes.summary: Turns a flow destination into a readable label from the override catalog, falls back to the route, and appends any feature names.

nodes.name: updateParam
nodes.summary: Persists a changed config value through Configurator and replaces that param in state with a copy whose default value is the new value.

nodes.name: onCleared
nodes.summary: Refreshes ConvergenceConfiguration from the stored values when the dev options ViewModel is cleared, so GPS convergence uses the edited settings.

nodes.name: updateListItem
nodes.summary: Generic List extension that returns a copy in which one matching item is replaced by the result of a transform lambda.

nodes.name: updateMutableItem
nodes.summary: Generic MutableList extension that finds an item by equality, replaces it in place with the transformed value, and returns the list.

nodes.name: AppModule.kt
nodes.summary: The Koin appModule that wires the whole app: 18 ViewModels, repositories, uploaders and use cases, Android system services, Firebase and JSON singletons, a debug-only sync progress tracker, and scoped bindings for the capture setup and capture flow scopes.
nodes.languageNotes: Koin's module DSL uses viewModel, single, factory and scope<T> { scoped } blocks; the image review and tree height bindings call CaptureFlowScopeManager.restoreAt so that Navigation 3 can rebuild them after process death.

nodes.name: LanguagePickerViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the language picker: the screen holds a pending language selection, follows the stored language, and applies the choice through LanguageSwitcher only on confirm.

nodes.name: LanguagePickerState
nodes.summary: Language picker UI state with the currently selected language, or null before one is known.

nodes.name: LanguagePickerAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of language picker intents: select a language, confirm it, or move on to the next screen.

nodes.name: LanguagePickerViewModel
nodes.summary: Seeds state from the current app language and keeps it in sync with the stored preference flow, so an external language change replaces a pending selection.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Stores a tapped language only in state and calls LanguageSwitcher.setLanguage on confirm; NavigateNext is intentionally a no-op that the composable handles.

nodes.name: MapViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State and ViewModel for the tree map screen: it loads every captured tree as a marker and the GPS points recorded in tree sessions as step points, and tracks the selected marker and its session.

nodes.name: MapMarker
nodes.summary: Map pin model for one captured tree with coordinates, upload status, note, plant date, photo path and optional session ID.

nodes.name: StepPoint
nodes.summary: A single recorded location fix that belongs to a capture session and is drawn as a path point on the map.

nodes.name: MapState
nodes.summary: Map UI state with tree markers, session step points, a loading flag, and the selected marker and session IDs.

nodes.name: MapAction
nodes.summary: Sealed map intent set with a single action that selects a marker by ID.

nodes.name: MapViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads map data once on creation from TreeTrackerDAO and updates the selection when a marker is tapped.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: On marker selection, stores the marker ID and the session ID of that marker so the screen can highlight its session path.

nodes.name: loadData
nodes.summary: Reads all trees and tree-session locations on the IO dispatcher, builds MapMarkers, and decodes each location JSON into a StepPoint, skipping and logging entries that fail to parse.

nodes.name: AnnouncementViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions, ViewModel and factory for the announcement detail screen: it loads one announcement message by ID, shows its sender, subject, body and video link, and marks it as read.

nodes.name: AnnouncementState
nodes.summary: Announcement screen state with the sender plus the current title, body and optional link URL.

nodes.name: AnnouncementAction
nodes.summary: Sealed announcement intents for navigating back or opening the announcement link.

nodes.name: AnnouncementViewModel
nodes.summary: Fetches the announcement from MessagesRepo on creation, maps it into state, and marks the message as read.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Pops the back stack on NavigateBack and leaves OpenLink to the screen, which starts an Intent.

nodes.name: AnnouncementViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider factory that passes the message ID and a Koin-resolved MessagesRepo into AnnouncementViewModel.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds an AnnouncementViewModel for the factory's message ID with MessagesRepo from Koin and casts it to the requested type.

nodes.name: ChatViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions, ViewModel and factory for a direct-message chat between the current grower and one other party: it streams the conversation, marks incoming messages read, sends drafts, and helps the UI group bubbles by author.

nodes.name: ChatState
nodes.summary: Chat screen state with the other party's identifier, the message list, the draft text and the current user.

nodes.name: ChatAction
nodes.summary: Sealed chat intents for editing the draft, sending it, and navigating back.

nodes.name: ChatViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads the current user, collects the direct-message flow between their wallet and the other identifier, and marks unread messages as read on every emission.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Updates the draft text, or saves the draft as a new message from the current user's wallet and then clears it.

nodes.name: checkChatAuthor
nodes.summary: Tells the UI whether the message at an index is the first or the last in a run by the same author, by comparing it with its neighbours.

nodes.name: checkIsOtherUser
nodes.summary: Returns whether the message at an index came from the other chat party rather than the current user.

nodes.name: ChatViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider factory that creates ChatViewModel for a user ID and other chat identifier and resolves the repositories through Koin.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Instantiates ChatViewModel with the factory's IDs and the UserRepo and MessagesRepo that Koin provides.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions, ViewModel and factory for one grower's message inbox: it merges the latest message of each external chat, incomplete surveys and announcements into one list with the newest first.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListState
nodes.summary: Inbox state with the visible messages, the selected message and the current user.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListAction
nodes.summary: Sealed inbox intents for selecting a message, going back, or opening the selected message.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads the user by ID and collects their message flow from MessagesRepo, and rebuilds the inbox list each time the flow changes.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Stores the tapped message as the selection; the screen handles the navigation actions.

nodes.name: updateMessages
nodes.summary: Builds the inbox: the newest direct message per external sender, surveys not yet completed, and all announcements, sorted by composition time.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider factory that builds the inbox ViewModel for a user ID with Koin-resolved repositories.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates IndividualMessageListViewModel for the factory's user ID with UserRepo and MessagesRepo from Koin.

nodes.name: ConvergenceConfiguration.kt
nodes.summary: Holds the GPS convergence settings used when the app captures a tree location, and rebuilds them from developer option values for timeout, sample size and latitude and longitude standard-deviation thresholds.

nodes.name: ConvergenceConfiguration
nodes.summary: Keeps a read-only LocationDataConfig that loads at construction and can be refreshed after dev options change.

nodes.name: refreshConfig
nodes.summary: Rebuilds LocationDataConfig from the Configurator's convergence timeout, data size and standard-deviation thresholds.

nodes.name: LocationDataConfig
nodes.summary: Data class of location update and convergence parameters with defaults: 1 second between updates, a 20 second timeout, 5 samples, and 0.00001 degree deviation thresholds.

nodes.name: LanguageSwitcher.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the supported app languages (English, Swahili, Portuguese) and a LanguageSwitcher that stores the chosen language in user preferences and applies it as the per-app locale through AppCompatDelegate.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.summary: Enum of supported languages, each with its Locale, plus a parser for the language codes en, sw and pt.

nodes.name: fromString
nodes.summary: Maps a language code, case-insensitively, to a Language entry and returns null for unsupported codes.

nodes.name: LanguageSwitcher
nodes.summary: Service that persists the selected language under a user-settings preference key and pushes it to the AppCompat application locales.

nodes.name: applyCurrentLanguage
nodes.summary: Reads the stored language tag and re-applies it as the app locale when it maps to a supported language.

nodes.name: setLanguage
nodes.summary: Commits the language tag to preferences and sets the application locales to that language.

nodes.name: currentLanguage
nodes.summary: Returns the stored Language, or null when no supported language has been saved.

nodes.name: observeCurrentLanguage
nodes.summary: Exposes a Flow of the stored language that emits whenever the preference changes and drops unknown values.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerViewModelFactory.kt
nodes.summary: Central ViewModelProvider factory for the Compose screens: it resolves 17 screen ViewModels from Koin by class and fails with a clear message when a ViewModel is not registered.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: NewInstanceFactory and KoinComponent that the Root composable provides through a CompositionLocal, so any screen can obtain its ViewModel.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Matches the requested class against each known ViewModel type, returns the Koin instance, and throws a RuntimeException that asks the developer to update the factory for unknown types.

nodes.name: CaptureFlowData.kt
nodes.summary: Minimal data holder for the capture flow scope with an optional tree photo path and note; Koin creates one instance per capture flow scope.

nodes.name: CaptureFlowData
nodes.summary: Data class with nullable treePhoto and note fields, scoped to one tree capture flow.

nodes.name: InstallReferrerDataSource.kt
nodes.summary: Abstraction over the Google Play Install Referrer API that the app uses to discover an org link at first launch; it returns Available, Unsupported or Unavailable results instead of exposing the callback-based client.
nodes.languageNotes: awaitSetup bridges the listener API into a suspend function with suspendCancellableCoroutine and an AtomicBoolean guard, so the continuation resumes only once.

nodes.name: InstallReferrerResult
nodes.summary: Sealed result of a referrer lookup: Available with the referrer string, Unsupported when the Play Store cannot help, or Unavailable for a transient failure to retry later.

nodes.name: InstallReferrerDataSource
nodes.summary: Functional interface with one suspend fetch method, so tests can supply a fake referrer source.

nodes.name: PlayInstallReferrerDataSource
nodes.summary: Production data source that opens an InstallReferrerClient, waits for setup, and always ends the connection afterwards.

nodes.name: fetch
nodes.summary: Builds an InstallReferrerClient, awaits the setup result, and closes the connection in a finally block, ignoring errors on close.

nodes.name: awaitSetup
nodes.summary: Suspends until the referrer service answers: OK reads the referrer string, FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED gives Unsupported, and any other code or a disconnect gives Unavailable.

nodes.name: OrgFeature.kt
nodes.summary: Type-safe org feature flags: an OrgFeature enum maps feature keys from org flow JSON (today only forceNote), and FeatureResolver checks whether a feature is enabled for a route in the current org's capture or setup flow.

nodes.name: OrgFeature
nodes.summary: Enum of per-destination org features keyed by their JSON string, currently FORCE_NOTE for mandatory tree notes.

nodes.name: fromKey
nodes.summary: Looks up an OrgFeature by its JSON key and logs a warning for an unknown key before it returns null.

nodes.name: FeatureResolver
nodes.summary: Koin-injected helper that answers feature questions for ViewModels by searching the current org's flow destinations.

nodes.name: isCaptureFlowFeatureEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns true when the current org's capture flow destination for the given route lists the requested feature.

nodes.name: isSetupFlowFeatureEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns true when the current org's capture setup flow destination for the given route lists the requested feature.

nodes.name: OrgRepo.kt
nodes.summary: Repository for organizations: it seeds the default Greenstand org, persists and restores the current org ID, adds orgs from a Remote Config JSON or as minimal fallbacks, drops unknown flow routes, and exposes the current org with debug overrides applied.

nodes.name: OrgRepo
nodes.summary: Owns the in-memory current Org, backed by the Room organization table and a preference key, and converts stored flow JSON into Destination lists.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Inserts the default org, loads the stored current org ID, and falls back to the default org when that ID is missing from the database.

nodes.name: ensureInitialized
nodes.summary: Re-runs init only when the current org is null, which repairs state after Android restores the app into a deep screen without the splash screen.

nodes.name: defaultOrgEntity
nodes.summary: Builds the default Greenstand OrganizationEntity whose setup flow is user select then add org and whose capture flow is capture then image review.

nodes.name: getOrgs
nodes.summary: Returns every stored organization converted to Org models.

nodes.name: setOrg
nodes.summary: Commits a new current org ID to preferences, loads that org, and falls back to the default org if it is not found.

nodes.name: currentOrg
nodes.summary: Returns the current org with any active debug overrides from OrgOverrideStore applied on top.

nodes.name: baseCurrentOrg
nodes.summary: Returns the current org exactly as configured, or throws when OrgRepo has not been initialized.

nodes.name: addOrgFromRemoteConfig
nodes.summary: Parses an org config JSON for wallet ID, version, setup flow and capture flow, validates the routes, stores and selects the org, and falls back to a minimal org on any parse error.

nodes.name: addMinimalOrg
nodes.summary: Stores and selects an org with only an ID, a name and default flows (user select for setup, capture then image review), and returns false if that also fails.

nodes.name: validateOrgRoutes
nodes.summary: Decodes both flow lists, logs and removes routes that RouteRegistry does not recognize, and returns the entity with the cleaned JSON.

nodes.name: toOrg
nodes.summary: Private extension that decodes an OrganizationEntity's flow JSON into Destination lists and builds the Org domain model.

nodes.name: RouteRegistry.kt
nodes.summary: Registry that bridges route strings stored in org config JSON to typed Navigation 3 route keys, and supports legacy patterned routes and newer stable aliases such as tree-capture and image-review.

nodes.name: RouteRegistry
nodes.summary: Singleton object of stable route IDs, a map of no-argument routes to NavKeys, the patterns of routes that need arguments, and alias mappings.

nodes.name: resolveNoArgRoute
nodes.summary: Returns the NavKey for a no-argument route string, trying a direct match before alias resolution, or null for unknown or argument routes.

nodes.name: isValidRoute
nodes.summary: Reports whether a route string is a known no-argument route, an argument route pattern, or an alias.

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.summary: Maps an alias to its canonical route string and returns any other string unchanged.

nodes.name: AddOrgViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the Add org step of capture setup: it pre-fills the current org name, offers the previously used org as autofill, writes the name into the setup scope, and recovers after process death.

nodes.name: AddOrgState
nodes.summary: Add org UI state with the entered and previous org names, the setup user's photo, and restoring and setupLost flags for process-death recovery.

nodes.name: AddOrgAction
nodes.summary: Sealed Add org intents: edit the org name, apply the autofill, save it as the default, and navigate back or next.

nodes.name: AddOrgViewModel
nodes.summary: Reopens the setup scope if needed, reloads the setup user, and fills state with the non-default current org name and the remembered previous org.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Ignores input once setup is lost; otherwise writes typed or autofilled org names to state and the setup scope, and remembers a non-blank name as the next autofill value.

nodes.name: OrgPickerViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the org picker, which lists stored organizations and switches the current org through OrgRepo.

nodes.name: OrgPickerState
nodes.summary: Org picker state with all stored orgs and the current one.

nodes.name: OrgPickerAction
nodes.summary: Sealed org picker intents for choosing an org and leaving the screen.

nodes.name: OrgPickerViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads the org list and current org on creation and reloads the current org after each switch.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Sets the chosen org as current and refreshes state, or pops the back stack on NavigateNext.

nodes.name: PermissionViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, action and ViewModel for the permissions screen, which checks whether the GPS provider is enabled and starts GPS updates once location permission is granted.

nodes.name: PermissionItemsState
nodes.summary: Permission screen state with a nullable flag that tells whether the GPS provider is enabled.

nodes.name: PermissionAction
nodes.summary: Sealed permission intents with a single action that checks location availability.

nodes.name: PermissionViewModel
nodes.summary: Uses LocationManager and LocationDataCapturer to report GPS availability to the permission screen.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Starts GPS updates (needed when permission was granted after first launch) and records whether the GPS provider is enabled.

nodes.name: Root.kt
nodes.summary: Top-level composable of the app UI: it provides the ViewModel factory and snackbar controller as CompositionLocals, re-hydrates OrgRepo before it renders the navigation host, and shows app-wide green snackbars.
nodes.languageNotes: LocalViewModelFactory is a compositionLocalOf that throws when unset, so a screen fails fast if it renders outside Root.

nodes.name: Root
nodes.summary: Shows the splash until OrgRepo.ensureInitialized finishes, then the Navigation 3 Host with the start route and initial back stack, while it collects snackbar events and shows them with a test tag.

nodes.name: SessionNoteViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the optional session note step of capture setup: it stores the typed note in the setup scope and recovers the setup user after process death.

nodes.name: SessionNoteState
nodes.summary: Session note UI state with the note text, the setup user's photo, and restoring and setupLost flags.

nodes.name: SessionNoteAction
nodes.summary: Sealed session note intents for editing the note and navigating back or next.

nodes.name: SessionNoteViewModel
nodes.summary: Reopens a closed setup scope through CaptureSetupRestorer, reloads the user for the header photo, and marks the setup as lost when the user is gone.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Writes the note to both the capture setup scope and the UI state, and ignores all input once setup is lost.

nodes.name: SettingsViewmodel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and ViewModel for the settings screen: privacy and logout dialogs, navigation to profile, map, tree editing and account deletion, and a logout that clears the power-user flag and returns to sign-up.

nodes.name: SettingsState
nodes.summary: Settings UI state with privacy, logout and delete-account dialog flags and the current power user.

nodes.name: SettingsAction
nodes.summary: Sealed settings intents that cover dialog visibility, logout and its confirmation, and navigation to profile, map, account deletion, tree editing or back.

nodes.name: SettingsViewModel
nodes.summary: Loads the power user from UserRepo and maps settings actions to dialog state changes or typed navigation routes.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Updates dialog flags, navigates to settings destinations, and on confirmed logout clears the power-user status and navigates to the sign-up flow as the new single-top root.

nodes.name: SignupViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, credential types, actions and ViewModel for grower sign-up: phone or email entry, existing-user detection, name validation, the selfie and privacy dialogs, and creation of the new user, where the first account becomes the power user.

nodes.name: SignUpState
nodes.summary: Sign-up UI state with names, email, phone, photo, credential type and validity, the existing-user match, internet and power-user flags, dialog flags, and name errors.

nodes.name: Credential
nodes.summary: Sealed credential type with Email and Phone variants that each hold mutable text and validate it with the shared Validation rules.

nodes.name: SignupAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of sign-up intents for editing names and credentials, submitting, handling the existing-user and tutorial dialogs, promoting an existing user, and camera or back navigation.

nodes.name: SignupViewModel
nodes.summary: Checks connectivity and whether initial setup is needed, reduces sign-up actions, checks whether the entered wallet already exists, and creates the user after the selfie.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Reduces every sign-up action: filters names, lowercases emails, validates phones, switches the credential type, toggles dialogs, submits the credential, and promotes an existing user to power user.

nodes.name: updateName
nodes.summary: Filters raw name input, validates it, and applies the filtered value and error through a state update that the caller supplies.

nodes.name: submitInfo
nodes.summary: Looks up the entered phone or email wallet and either shows the existing user or advances from the credential view to the name view.

nodes.name: isFormValid
nodes.summary: Returns true only when both the first and the last name pass ValidationUtils.validateName.

nodes.name: isInitialSetupRequired
nodes.summary: Reports whether no power user exists, which means this sign-up sets up the device's first admin.

nodes.name: createUser
nodes.summary: When a selfie path is given, saves the new user with the entered names and wallet, makes them the power user if none exists, and returns the stored user.

nodes.name: extractIdentifier
nodes.summary: Returns the email or phone that matches the selected credential type as the wallet, or DEFAULT when it is missing.

nodes.name: TreeHeightViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, action and ViewModel for the tree height step, where the grower picks one of five colored buttons and the app saves the color index as a tree attribute.

nodes.name: TreeHeightSelectionState
nodes.summary: Tree height UI state with the five ordered height button colors and the selected color.

nodes.name: TreeHeightAction
nodes.summary: Sealed tree height intent with a single action that selects a color.

nodes.name: TreeHeightSelectionViewModel
nodes.summary: Records the chosen height color on the current tree, and returns to the dashboard when a process-death restore lost the tree.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Saves the index of the selected color as the tree color attribute through TreeCapturer and marks that color as selected.

nodes.name: UserSelectViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions, ViewModel and factory for selecting a grower profile: it lists users, starts capture setup and GPS, supports editing and saving a profile, and deletes an account locally while it sends a message to an admin.

nodes.name: UserSelectState
nodes.summary: User select state with the user list, the selected user, an edit-mode flag, and the delete-profile dialog state.

nodes.name: DeleteProfileState
nodes.summary: Enum of delete-profile dialog stages, from initial and dialog shown or dismissed to deleted locally or deleted with an admin request sent.

nodes.name: UserSelectAction
nodes.summary: Sealed user select intents: select, delete or edit a user, update and save profile fields, change the delete dialog state, and navigate.

nodes.name: UserSelectViewModel
nodes.summary: Observes users from UserRepo, opens the capture setup scope with GPS on creation, and handles selection, profile editing and deletion.

nodes.name: resumeSetup
nodes.summary: Reopens the capture setup scope and clears the stale selection when capture ended setup while this ViewModel stayed alive on the back stack.

nodes.name: startSetup
nodes.summary: Opens the capture setup scope and starts GPS updates.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Stores the selected user in preferences and the setup scope, toggles edit mode, updates or saves the profile, and changes the delete dialog state.

nodes.name: deleteUser
nodes.summary: Deletes the selected user by wallet, queues a deletion request message to the admin, and tries to sync it, logging instead of crashing when the sync fails.

nodes.name: updateSelectedUser
nodes.summary: Copies the selected user with any provided name, wallet (phone or email) and photo changes and puts the copy back in state.

nodes.name: UserSelectViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider factory that creates UserSelectViewModel with a given user ID preselected and its dependencies from Koin.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds UserSelectViewModel for the factory's user ID with UserRepo, MessagesRepo, LocationDataCapturer and Preferences from Koin.

nodes.name: GpsUtils.kt
nodes.summary: Small utility that checks whether the device has a GPS location provider; the main activity uses it to block the app on hardware without GPS.

nodes.name: GpsUtils
nodes.summary: Context-holding helper class, provided by Koin as a singleton, for GPS hardware checks.

nodes.name: hasGPSDevice
nodes.summary: Returns true when the LocationManager's provider list contains the GPS provider.

nodes.name: ImageCaptureActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Hosts the standalone selfie capture flow as its own Activity with a Navigation 3 back stack (selfie, then image review), and defines CaptureImageContract so callers can launch it and receive the approved photo path as the activity result.

nodes.name: Camera.kt
nodes.summary: Wraps CameraX in a Compose Camera composable that binds preview and still-capture use cases to the lifecycle, tracks display rotation, and saves, resizes, and orients each photo; CameraControl lets screens trigger a capture from outside the preview.
nodes.languageNotes: DisposableEffect registers the display and layout listeners and unbinds the CameraX use cases on dispose, and rememberUpdatedState makes the asynchronous capture callback always call the latest onImageCaptured lambda.

nodes.name: ImageReviewScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Shows the just-taken selfie with approve and reject buttons; approving returns the photo path to the caller through the activity result and finishes the capture activity, while rejecting navigates back to a fresh selfie screen.

nodes.name: SelfieScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Selfie capture screen for grower sign-up that drives the front camera, shows an optional selfie tutorial from SignupViewModel state, and navigates to image review with the captured file path.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Main tree capture screen: it requests permissions, shows the rear camera preview, starts a GPS fix when the capture button is pressed, and handles the bad-GPS dialog, the capture tutorial, the profile shortcut, and a debug or beta button that creates fake trees.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Tree photo review step of the capture flow where the grower approves or declines the captured image, adds an optional note through a dialog, and sees a review tutorial; every UI event goes to the view model as a TreeImageReviewAction.

nodes.name: DashboardScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Home dashboard that shows synced and pending tree counts with an animated semicircle upload gauge, plus large buttons to upload, open messages, start tracking, and open settings; it can show a sync reminder dialog before tracking starts.

nodes.name: CaptureImageContract
nodes.summary: ActivityResultContract that takes a selfie-mode flag as input and returns the saved image path, or null when the user cancels; it defines the SELFIE_MODE and TAKEN_IMAGE_PATH extra keys.

nodes.name: createIntent
nodes.summary: Builds the explicit Intent that starts ImageCaptureActivity and puts the selfie-mode flag in the SELFIE_MODE extra.

nodes.name: parseResult
nodes.summary: Reads the TAKEN_IMAGE_PATH extra from the returned Intent when the result code is RESULT_OK, and returns null for any other result code.

nodes.name: ImageCaptureActivity
nodes.summary: ComponentActivity that runs the selfie and image review screens apart from the main app navigation, so the photo can go back to the caller as an activity result.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Enables edge-to-edge drawing and sets Compose content with a back stack that starts at SelfieRoute, a Navigator provided through LocalNavigator, fade transitions, and entries for the selfie and image review routes.

nodes.name: Camera
nodes.summary: Creates a PreviewView and, in a DisposableEffect, binds front or back camera preview and ImageCapture use cases (square 1000 px for selfies, 16:9 maximum quality for trees), keeps the target rotation in sync with the display, and installs a capture listener that saves, resizes, and orients the photo before it calls onImageCaptured.

nodes.name: CameraControl
nodes.summary: Small mutable handle that a screen shares with the Camera composable; it holds the capture listener and the image scaling settings (an enabled flag and a target height that defaults to 1920).

nodes.name: captureImage
nodes.summary: Invokes the capture listener that the Camera composable installed, so a button outside the preview can take a photo; it does nothing while no camera is bound.

nodes.name: ImageReviewScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper that wires reject to a single-top navigation back to SelfieRoute, and wires approve to setting RESULT_OK with the photo path on the hosting Activity and finishing it.

nodes.name: ImageReview
nodes.summary: Stateless review layout that draws the local photo with ContentScale.Fit above a bottom row of reject and approve ApprovalButtons.

nodes.name: SelfieScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful selfie screen that creates a CameraControl, reads the selfie tutorial flag from SignupViewModel, and passes a front-camera Camera preview whose captured file navigates to ImageReviewRoute.

nodes.name: Selfie
nodes.summary: Stateless selfie layout with a title top bar, capture and info buttons in the bottom bar, a square camera preview slot sized to the smaller screen dimension, and the selfie tutorial overlay when it is requested.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful capture screen that builds TreeCaptureViewModel for the grower's profile picture, applies the image scaling settings to CameraControl, requests permissions, sends back presses to the dashboard, and maps button callbacks to TreeCaptureAction values such as CaptureLocation and OnImageCaptured.

nodes.name: TreeCapture
nodes.summary: Stateless tree capture layout with back, capture, and info buttons, a full-screen camera preview slot, the poor-GPS dialog and capture tutorial when the state asks for them, a profile image button, and a fake-tree button that only debug or beta builds show.

nodes.name: CaptureCustomLoading
nodes.summary: Translucent bottom card shown while the GPS fix converges or fake trees are being created, with a tracking message, a spinner, and the convergence percentage.

nodes.name: TreeImageReviewScreen
nodes.summary: Collects TreeImageReviewViewModel state, wires UI events through HandleUIEvents, and forwards every user action to the handleAction function of the view model.

nodes.name: TreeImageReview
nodes.summary: Stateless review layout with a Note button in the top bar, decline, approve, and info buttons at the bottom, the captured tree image, and the note dialog or review tutorial when the state enables them.

nodes.name: NoteDialog
nodes.summary: CustomDialog with a text input bound to the tree note that sends UpdateNote on each edit, AddNote on confirm, and closes the dialog on cancel.

nodes.name: DashboardScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful dashboard that collects DashboardViewModel state, keeps a local flag for the sync reminder dialog, and maps buttons to the Sync and SyncMessages actions or to throttled navigation to the user select, messages, org, and settings routes.

nodes.name: Dashboard
nodes.summary: Stateless dashboard layout that can show the upload-soon reminder dialog and stacks the header, the upload stats, the messages button, and the track button in weighted rows under the top bar.

nodes.name: DashboardHeader
nodes.summary: Private header row that shows a leaf icon next to the total count of trees that are already synced.

nodes.name: DashboardStats
nodes.summary: Private row that pairs the upload progress gauge and the count of trees waiting to sync with a round orange upload button.

nodes.name: SyncStatusSection
nodes.summary: Despite its name, this private composable renders the purple Messages dashboard button, with a notification badge when unread messages exist.

nodes.name: DashboardActions
nodes.summary: Private green Track button that starts the tree capture flow from the dashboard.

nodes.name: DashboardTopBar
nodes.summary: Dashboard top bar with a settings icon on the left, the app title in the center, and the language button on the right; the old organization button is commented out, so onOrgClicked is unused.

nodes.name: DashboardUploadProgressBar
nodes.summary: Canvas-drawn semicircle gauge that animates upload progress as an orange arc over a gray background arc, with progress semantics for accessibility.

nodes.name: DashBoardButton
nodes.summary: Reusable large dashboard tile built on TreeTrackerButton with an icon, a bold caption, and an optional unread notification badge in the corner.

nodes.name: DashboardPreview
nodes.summary: Android Studio preview that renders the dashboard inside PreviewDependencies with sample tree counts and an unread message flag.

nodes.name: DevOptionsScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Developer options screen that lists switches for the sync and sensor debug overlays, editors for boolean, integer, and float config params, and the org link overrides section; it sends each edit to DevOptionsViewModel as an action.

nodes.name: OrgLinkOverridesSection.kt
nodes.summary: LazyListScope extension that adds the Org Link Overrides block to the dev options list, so testers can override per-org setup and capture flow steps, feature flags, and the wallet ID, and can see the resulting effective flows.
nodes.languageNotes: orgLinkOverridesSection is an extension function on LazyListScope rather than a composable, so it can append several item and items blocks directly into the caller's LazyColumn.

nodes.name: LanguageSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Language picker screen that lists every supported Language as a selectable button and, on confirm, saves the choice and either pops back (when opened from the top bar) or continues to the sign-up flow (during onboarding).

nodes.name: MapScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Map screen that initializes MapLibre, renders the LibreMap slot with captured tree markers and session step points, and overlays a back button and a horizontal carousel of tree cards that stays centered on the selected marker.

nodes.name: MessagesUserSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Messages entry screen that reuses the shared UserSelect component in purple messaging colors, with unread notifications on and user creation off, then opens the message list of the selected grower.

nodes.name: AnnouncementScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Announcement message screen that shows the sender badge, title, body, and an optional link; it opens the link in an external app with an ACTION_VIEW intent and sends all other actions to AnnouncementViewModel.

nodes.name: ChatScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Direct message chat screen with a reversed message list, sender-aligned chat bubbles, and a draft text field that sends on the IME Go action; it also exports the OtherChatIcon badge that the announcement screen reuses.
nodes.languageNotes: The file sits in the directmessages folder but declares package org.greenstand.android.TreeTracker.messages, which is why AnnouncementScreen imports OtherChatIcon from the messages package.

nodes.name: DevOptionsRoot
nodes.summary: Entry composable for dev options that gets DevOptionsViewModel from the shared factory, injects the DebugOverlayManager with Koin, and renders DevOptionsScreen.

nodes.name: DevOptionsScreen
nodes.summary: Stateless dev options list with a back button, switches for the sync and sensor debug overlays (off when no overlay manager is given), one editor per config param, and the org link overrides section when an org is present.

nodes.name: OverlayToggleItem
nodes.summary: Private labeled row with a green Switch that turns one debug overlay on or off.

nodes.name: ParamListItem
nodes.summary: Private dispatcher that picks the boolean, integer, or float editor for a Config entry and forwards the new value.

nodes.name: BooleanParamListItem
nodes.summary: Private row that shows the name of a boolean config param with a Checkbox that reflects its value.

nodes.name: IntParamListItem
nodes.summary: Private numeric text field for an integer config param that keeps the raw text locally and reports only values that parse as Int.

nodes.name: FloatParamListItem
nodes.summary: Private numeric text field for a float config param that reports only text that parses as Float and ignores all other input.

nodes.name: orgLinkOverridesSection
nodes.summary: Adds list items for the current org name and ID, an Apply overrides switch, override rows for setup steps, capture steps, and features, a wallet ID override field, the effective flow summaries, and a reset button, each of which sends a DevOptionsAction.

nodes.name: SectionHeader
nodes.summary: Private bold sky-blue heading used for the Org Link Overrides title in the dev options list.

nodes.name: SubHeader
nodes.summary: Private smaller bold heading that labels each override group, such as Setup flow, Capture flow, Features, and Wallet.

nodes.name: OverrideRow
nodes.summary: Private row for one org setting that shows the org default or the override state, a Reset button when the setting is overridden, and a Switch that is disabled for required settings.

nodes.name: LanguageSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper that intercepts NavigateNext to confirm the language, then pops back when opened from the top bar or goes to SignupFlowRoute during onboarding; it forwards other actions to LanguagePickerViewModel.

nodes.name: LanguageSelect
nodes.summary: Stateless list of language buttons with a next arrow that stays disabled until the grower selects a language.

nodes.name: LanguageTopBar
nodes.summary: Top bar for the language picker that shows only the centered app title.

nodes.name: LanguageButton
nodes.summary: Green selectable TreeTrackerButton for one language option, with a test tag made from the language name; it is separate from the top-bar language button in the view package.

nodes.name: MapScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful map screen that initializes MapLibre once, collects MapViewModel state, and passes a LibreMap with the OpenFreeMap liberty style whose marker taps send SelectMarker actions.

nodes.name: MapContent
nodes.summary: Stateless map layout that draws the map slot full screen with a floating back button and, when markers exist, the tree carousel at the bottom.

nodes.name: TreeMarkerCarousel
nodes.summary: Horizontal LazyRow of tree cards that scrolls with an offset to center the selected marker each time the selection changes.

nodes.name: TreeMarkerCard
nodes.summary: Card for one tree marker with the local tree photo (a placeholder on error), latitude and longitude to six decimals, the note, and the plant date; its size animates larger when it is selected.

nodes.name: formatPlantDate
nodes.summary: Converts a kotlinx Instant to the device time zone and formats it with the MMM dd, yyyy pattern for the tree card.

nodes.name: MessagesUserSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Composable that renders UserSelect with purple colors and notifications enabled and, on forward, does a throttled navigation to IndividualMessageListRoute with the planter info ID of the chosen user.

nodes.name: AnnouncementScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful announcement screen that builds AnnouncementViewModel for a message ID, wires HandleUIEvents, and handles OpenLink itself while it sends other actions to the view model.

nodes.name: Announcement
nodes.summary: Stateless announcement layout with the sender badge in the top bar, a purple back arrow in the bottom bar, and the announcement content in the body.

nodes.name: AnnouncementContent
nodes.summary: Private rounded card that shows the announcement title, the body, and an underlined link that sends OpenLink when tapped, each one only when it is present.

nodes.name: openUrlLink
nodes.summary: Starts an ACTION_VIEW activity for the given URL so that the link opens in a browser or another app.

nodes.name: ChatScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful chat screen that builds ChatViewModel for a user and a chat partner and maps back, draft edits, send, and the author checks to the view model.

nodes.name: Chat
nodes.summary: Stateless chat layout with the partner badge, a chat icon, and the photo of the current user in the top bar, the message list, and a two-line draft field that sends on IME Go.

nodes.name: OtherChatIcon
nodes.summary: BoxScope composable that draws a gray rounded badge with the sender name in upper case; the chat and announcement top bars both use it.

nodes.name: Messages
nodes.summary: Reversed LazyColumn of chat messages that asks the caller per index whether a message is from the other user and whether it starts an author run; it passes the same check for the first and last flags.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: One chat row that adds extra bottom padding after the last message of an author and a larger spacer after the first message in a run.

nodes.name: ChatItemBubble
nodes.summary: Chat bubble that left-aligns received messages on the received background and right-aligns the messages of the user on the author background.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListItem.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the purple selectable message card used in a grower's message grid: a tall icon header labelled with the message type, a one-line preview, and an unread notification badge.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageItem
nodes.summary: Renders one message card through SelectableImageDetail, with the Header composable on top and a single ellipsized preview line below; shows the notification icon when the message is unread.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Draws the 160dp purple header box of a message card, centering the type icon (with optional padding) and printing the upper-cased message type label beneath it.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Screen that lists one grower's direct messages, surveys and announcements in a two-column grid and opens the selected item in the chat, survey or announcement screen. It binds IndividualMessageListViewModel state to a stateless composable.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageListScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful entry composable: creates the view model for a user id, collects its state, and handles NavigateBack and NavigateToSelected itself with throttled navigation to ChatRoute, SurveyRoute or AnnouncementRoute by message type.

nodes.name: IndividualMessageList
nodes.summary: Stateless message grid with a user-photo top bar and back and forward arrows; draws a typed IndividualMessageItem for each DirectMessage, SurveyMessage or AnnouncementMessage, or the NoMessages placeholder when the list is empty.

nodes.name: SurveyScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Compose UI for answering a survey message one question at a time: shows the grower photo, the current prompt and a list of answer buttons, with arrow buttons to step back and forward.

nodes.name: SurveyScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful survey entry point that builds SurveyViewModel through SurveyViewModelFactory for a message id, subscribes to UI events with HandleUIEvents, and forwards user actions to the view model.

nodes.name: Survey
nodes.summary: Stateless survey layout in a Scaffold: a top bar with the user image, a centered question prompt, a lazy column of answer items, and a bottom bar whose forward arrow stays disabled until an answer is chosen.

nodes.name: UserImage
nodes.summary: BoxScope extension that centers the grower's rounded local photo in the action bar when an image path exists, and draws nothing otherwise.

nodes.name: QuestionPrompt
nodes.summary: Shows the current survey question as large centered light text, tagged SURVEY_QUESTION so UI tests can find it.

nodes.name: AnswerItem
nodes.summary: Full-width 68dp TreeTrackerButton for one survey choice that turns progress green when selected and accepts an optional test tag.

nodes.name: SurveyViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: State, actions and view model behind the survey screen: loads a SurveyMessage and its recipient's photo, records one answer per question, saves the answer strings through MessagesRepo after the last question, and shows a completion snackbar.

nodes.name: SurveyScreenState
nodes.summary: Immutable UI state for the survey screen holding the grower photo path, the current Question, and the index of the selected answer.

nodes.name: SurveyAction
nodes.summary: Sealed set of survey user actions (SelectAnswer with an index, GoToNextQuestion, GoToPrevQuestion, NavigateBack) that implements the shared Action marker interface.

nodes.name: SurveyViewModel
nodes.summary: BaseViewModel subclass that on init fetches the survey message and its user, shows the first question and marks the message read; it tracks the current question index and a fixed three-slot answers array.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Dispatches survey actions: stores the chosen answer for the current question and mirrors it into state, or delegates to the next and previous question helpers; other actions are ignored.

nodes.name: goToNextQuestion
nodes.summary: Advances to the next question, or on the last one maps stored indexes to choice strings, saves them with MessagesRepo.saveSurveyAnswers, sends a survey_completed snackbar and pops the back stack.

nodes.name: goToPrevQuestion
nodes.summary: Steps back one question and restores its saved answer, or leaves the screen with popBackStack when already on the first question.

nodes.name: SurveyViewModelFactory
nodes.summary: ViewModelProvider.Factory that is also a KoinComponent, so it can build a SurveyViewModel for a message id with MessagesRepo and UserRepo resolved from Koin.

nodes.name: FeatureFlags.kt
nodes.summary: Central singleton of build-time feature switches read from BuildConfig: debug and beta build detection plus toggles for tree height, tree note, DBH, automatic sign-out, blur detection and org links.

nodes.name: FeatureFlags
nodes.summary: Kotlin object exposing Boolean flags: DEBUG_ENABLED is true for the dev and debug build types, BETA for the beta build type, and the rest mirror BuildConfig fields set per build variant.

nodes.name: LeaveLostSetupEffect.kt
nodes.summary: Holds one composable side effect that returns a capture setup screen to the Dashboard when its setup state could not be restored after process death.

nodes.name: LeaveLostSetupEffect
nodes.summary: LaunchedEffect keyed on setupLost that pops back to DashboardRoute, or navigates to it with popUpToRoot when the restored back stack holds no Dashboard entry.

nodes.name: Navigator.kt
nodes.summary: App-owned navigation layer over a Navigation 3 back stack: provides the LocalNavigator composition local, a Nav2-style NavOptions DSL, and a Navigator with push, pop and pop-to operations plus throttled variants that block double-tap navigation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses reified inline generics (popUpTo<T>, popBackStackTo<T>) so callers pass a route type instead of a matcher lambda, and Snapshot.withMutableSnapshot to apply multi-step back stack edits atomically.

nodes.name: NavOptions
nodes.summary: Builder that mirrors the Navigation 2 NavOptionsBuilder surface, collecting launchSingleTop, a popUpTo matcher with an inclusive flag, and a pop-to-root request for one navigate call.

nodes.name: popUpTo
nodes.summary: Reified inline option that records a matcher for the most recent entry of route type T, and whether that entry is popped too, read from a PopUpToBuilder lambda.

nodes.name: popUpToRoot
nodes.summary: Requests that the whole back stack is cleared before the new route is pushed, replacing the Nav2 popUpTo(graph.id) inclusive idiom.

nodes.name: Navigator
nodes.summary: Navigation state holder whose backStack list is the single source of truth for NavDisplay. A view scoped to an origin entry lets throttled calls pass only while that screen is on top; an unscoped one falls back to a 300 ms debounce.

nodes.name: scopedTo
nodes.summary: Returns a new Navigator view bound to an origin content key that shares the same back stack and last-navigation timestamp, which gives each screen its own double-tap protection.

nodes.name: navigate
nodes.summary: Pushes a route after applying NavOptions inside one mutation: clears the stack for popUpToRoot, trims to the matched popUpTo entry, and replaces the top entry instead of adding when launchSingleTop matches the same route class.

nodes.name: popBackStack
nodes.summary: Removes the top back stack entry and returns true, but refuses and returns false when only one entry is left, matching Navigation 2 behavior.

nodes.name: popBackStackTo
nodes.summary: Pops entries until the newest entry that matches (or, through the reified inline overload, the newest route of type T) is on top, or removed when inclusive; never empties the stack and returns false when nothing would pop.

nodes.name: throttledNavigate
nodes.summary: Guarded form of navigate that silently drops the call when isThrottled reports that this screen may not navigate, which stops rapid double taps.

nodes.name: throttledPopBackStack
nodes.summary: Guarded form of popBackStack that returns false without popping when the navigator is throttled.

nodes.name: isThrottled
nodes.summary: Decides whether a throttled call is dropped: an origin-scoped navigator blocks unless its origin key equals the top entry, and an unscoped one blocks within 300 ms of the last stack change.

nodes.name: trimTo
nodes.summary: Removes entries from the end of the back stack until only keepCount remain; navigate and popBackStackTo use it.

nodes.name: mutate
nodes.summary: Runs a back stack change inside Snapshot.withMutableSnapshot so multi-step edits land in one frame, then records the mutation time used by throttling and millisSinceLastNavigation.

nodes.name: AddOrgScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Capture setup step where the grower types an organization name or taps a previously used one; it guards Next against the second tap of a double tap and against leaving before a restored setup has its user back.

nodes.name: AddOrgScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper that applies LeaveLostSetupEffect and a double-tap guard, blocks back and next while the setup is restoring or lost, and on Next saves the org as default before moving forward through CaptureSetupScopeManager navigation.

nodes.name: AddOrg
nodes.summary: Stateless form with a bordered organization-name text field (the IME Go key triggers Next), an optional autofill button showing the previous org name, and back and next arrows.

nodes.name: OrgPickerScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Organization selection screen that shows the available orgs as a two-column grid of buttons under a 'select organization' title, highlights the current one, and offers a Next arrow.

nodes.name: OrgPickerScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful entry that gets OrgPickerViewModel from the shared LocalViewModelFactory, subscribes to its UI events, and passes its state and action handler to OrgPicker.

nodes.name: OrgPicker
nodes.summary: Stateless Scaffold with an upper-cased title bar, a lazy grid of OrgItem buttons that send SetOrg on tap, and a bottom bar with a NavigateNext arrow.

nodes.name: OrgItem
nodes.summary: Progress-green TreeTrackerButton showing one organization name in upper case, with a selected state and an orgOption test tag.

nodes.name: DebugOverlayHost.kt
nodes.summary: Debug-only floating layer drawn above all screens that shows the sync and sensor overlays when enabled and provides a small 'D' button that opens a menu to toggle them.

nodes.name: DebugOverlayHost

nodes.name: OverlayToggleItem
nodes.summary: Private menu row with a green or gray status dot and a label, used to toggle one debug overlay on tap.

nodes.name: DebugOverlayManager.kt
nodes.summary: Small Koin singleton that records whether the debug sync and sensor overlays are visible, exposed as read-only StateFlows.

nodes.name: DebugOverlayManager
nodes.summary: Keeps two private MutableStateFlow<Boolean> values for the sync and sensor overlays with toggle and explicit set methods for each; DebugOverlayHost toggles them and the developer options screen sets them.

nodes.name: SensorOverlay.kt

nodes.name: SensorOverlay

nodes.name: GpsSection
nodes.summary: Shows the GPS block: a convergence ring, a CONVERGED, CONVERGING or TIMED OUT label, coordinates with accuracy or 'No GPS fix', and latitude and longitude standard deviation labels when known.

nodes.name: StdDevLabel
nodes.summary: Prints a labelled standard deviation to seven decimals, green when it is below its threshold and red when it is above or unknown.

nodes.name: ConvergenceRing
