nodes.name: StepSection
nodes.summary: Shows the step counter block: the delta step count while the listener is active, otherwise 'idle' or 'no sensor', with a colored status dot.

nodes.name: SectionHeader
nodes.summary: Small sky-blue bold caption that titles the GPS and Steps blocks of the sensor overlay.

nodes.name: StatusDot
nodes.summary: Six-dp colored circle used as a compact status indicator in the sensor overlay header and step section.

nodes.name: SyncOverlay.kt
nodes.summary: Draggable debug card that shows live data sync progress: an overall progress bar, one row per sync step with status color and item counts, and any overall or per-step error text.

nodes.name: SyncOverlay
nodes.summary: Collects SyncProgressTracker state, computes completed versus total steps for an animated overall progress bar, shows the count, Error or Done in the header, and lists step rows plus the overall error when expanded.

nodes.name: SyncStepRow
nodes.summary: Renders one sync step with an animated status-colored dot, its display name, item counts, a per-step progress bar while running, and an error message that expands on tap.

nodes.name: SyncProgressTracker.kt
nodes.summary: Model and tracker for data sync progress: lists the sync steps (messages, device config, users, sessions, legacy trees, trees, locations), their statuses and item counts, exposes the state as a StateFlow, and adds a no-op subclass for non-debug builds.

nodes.name: SyncStep
nodes.summary: Enum of the seven ordered sync stages, each with a human-readable display name for the overlay.

nodes.name: StepStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of the lifecycle states of a sync step: PENDING, RUNNING, SUCCESS and ERROR.

nodes.name: SyncStepState
nodes.summary: Immutable per-step progress record with the step, its status, total and completed item counts, and an optional error message.

nodes.name: SyncProgressState
nodes.summary: Immutable snapshot of a whole sync run: whether it is active, the current step, one SyncStepState per SyncStep, and an overall error.

nodes.name: SyncProgressTracker
nodes.summary: Open tracker that holds SyncProgressState in a MutableStateFlow and offers open methods to start a run, start, update, complete or fail a step, and end the run; sync code reports to it and the debug overlay observes it.

nodes.name: startSync
nodes.summary: Resets the tracker to an active run with every SyncStep back in the pending state.

nodes.name: startStep
nodes.summary: Marks the given sync step as RUNNING and records it as the current step.

nodes.name: updateStepProgress
nodes.summary: Stores completed and total item counts for the given step so the overlay can draw a per-step progress bar.

nodes.name: completeStep
nodes.summary: Sets the status of the given sync step to SUCCESS and leaves the other steps unchanged.

nodes.name: failStep
nodes.summary: Sets the given sync step to ERROR and attaches the supplied error message to it.

nodes.name: endSync
nodes.summary: Finishes the run by clearing the active flag and current step and recording an optional overall error.

nodes.name: NoOpSyncProgressTracker
nodes.summary: Subclass that the Koin module binds when debug is off; it overrides every tracker method with an empty body so sync code can report progress without StateFlow churn.

nodes.name: Permissions.kt
nodes.summary: Runtime permission flow for location, camera and (on Android 10 and later) activity recognition: requests them on every ON_START, shows rationale or open-settings dialogs, and opens location settings when location is off. The file is in permissions/ but declares the models package.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Accompanist rememberMultiplePermissionsState together with a LifecycleEventObserver registered in DisposableEffect, so the permission request runs again each time the screen reaches ON_START.

nodes.name: PermissionRequest
nodes.summary: Builds the permission list, launches the multi-permission request on each lifecycle ON_START, and per permission shows a camera or location rationale dialog or the permanent-denial dialog, or checks location services through PermissionViewModel and opens settings when they are off.

nodes.name: LocationRationaleDialog
nodes.summary: CustomDialog that explains why location access is needed; confirming relaunches the permission request, and both buttons pop the back stack through the throttled navigator.

nodes.name: enableLocation
nodes.summary: Composable helper that starts the system location source settings activity from the current Activity context.

nodes.name: PermissionDeniedPermanentlyDialog
nodes.summary: CustomDialog shown after a permission is permanently denied that opens the app details page in system settings on confirm, or pops the back stack on cancel.

nodes.name: DeleteProfileScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Profile deletion screen that reuses the user selection grid: choosing a user opens a confirmation dialog, and after deletion an 'account deleted' dialog sends power users to sign-up and other users back to settings.

nodes.name: DeleteProfileScreen
nodes.summary: Drives UserSelectViewModel through DeleteProfileState: SHOWDIALOG shows a confirm dialog with the user's button, the deleted states show an acknowledgement dialog, and confirming it navigates to SignupFlowRoute with popUpToRoot for power users or back to SettingsRoute for others.

nodes.name: ProfileScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Profile viewer and editor for one grower: shows the photo, first and last name and wallet (email or phone), lets the user retake the photo through the image capture contract, and validates names before saving.

nodes.name: ProfileScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful entry that builds UserSelectViewModel for a user id, registers a CaptureImageContract launcher that stores a new photo path, and maps NavigateBack, NavigateToPhoto and SaveUserToDatabase (save, then leave edit mode) to their effects.

nodes.name: Profile
nodes.summary: Stateless scrollable profile form with a photo that is clickable in edit mode, an edit or cancel toggle, filtered and validated name fields with inline errors, an email or phone field chosen by whether the wallet contains '@', and a save button gated on valid names.

nodes.name: ProfileSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Thin screen that reuses the shared UserSelect grid to pick a grower and then opens that grower's profile.

nodes.name: ProfileSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Calls UserSelect with progress-green navigation buttons and, when a user is chosen, throttled-navigates to ProfileRoute with the planter info id of that user.

nodes.name: Host.kt
nodes.summary: Root navigation host of the app: keeps a saveable Navigation 3 back stack, provides the Navigator through LocalNavigator, maps every route type to its screen composable in NavDisplay with fast fade transitions, and adds the debug overlay in debug builds.

nodes.name: Host
nodes.summary: Creates the back stack with rememberNavBackStack (restored after process death), wraps it in a Navigator, configures NavDisplay with state, view model and screen-tracking entry decorators plus one entry per route (including TreeHeightScreen and DevOptionsRoot), and injects the debug overlay dependencies from Koin when FeatureFlags.DEBUG_ENABLED.

nodes.name: SessionNoteScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Compose screen in the capture setup flow where the grower types an optional note for the tracking session before moving on. It blocks navigation while a restored session still waits for its user, and it drops the second tap of the double tap that opened it.

nodes.name: SessionNoteScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful entry composable that collects SessionNoteViewModel state, runs LeaveLostSetupEffect, and routes Back and Next through CaptureSetupScopeManager. Next is ignored while setup is restoring or lost, or when it is the second tap of a double tap.

nodes.name: SessionNote
nodes.summary: Stateless session note layout with back and next arrow buttons in an ActionBar and a BorderedTextField for the note text. The keyboard Go action also sends NavigateNext.

nodes.name: SettingsScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Settings screen that lists profile, tree editing, map, and privacy policy entries, debug-only logout and delete-account entries, and the app version line. It wires SettingsViewModel actions, HandleUIEvents, and the privacy and logout confirmation dialogs.

nodes.name: SettingsScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper that obtains SettingsViewModel from the shared view model factory, subscribes to its UI events, and initializes the MapLibre singleton once in a LaunchedEffect.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Stateless settings list that shows the map entry only in debug or beta builds and the logout and delete-account entries only in debug builds. It overlays PrivacyPolicyDialog, or a logout CustomDialog that shows the power user, from state flags.

nodes.name: SettingsItem
nodes.summary: Reusable clickable settings row with a 24dp icon, an optional icon tint, a bold title, a gray description, and an optional test tag.

nodes.name: CredentialEntryView.kt
nodes.summary: First signup step where a new grower picks phone or email as the wallet credential and types it. It shows validation snackbars, a link to the live web map when online, and dialogs for an existing user or the privacy policy.
nodes.languageNotes: A generic composable, CredentialButton<T : Credential>, uses a Class<T> token and isInstance to decide the selected state for each sealed Credential subtype.

nodes.name: CredentialEntryView
nodes.summary: Top-level signup credential layout: an ActionBar with the logo and language button, the credential form, and conditional ExistingUserDialog and PrivacyPolicyDialog overlays.

nodes.name: CredentialBottomBar
nodes.summary: Bottom bar with back and next arrows that submits the credential when it is valid, or shows the email or phone validation error snackbar. It is hidden while the privacy dialog is open.

nodes.name: CredentialFormContent
nodes.summary: Scrollable column with the red error snackbar host, the credential type selector, the active text field, and a web map link that opens the Treetracker website through a browser intent.

nodes.name: CredentialTypeSelector
nodes.summary: Row of the phone and email toggle buttons that changes the credential type in the signup state.

nodes.name: CredentialTextField
nodes.summary: Picks the email or the phone text field from the current Credential subtype and maps the field callbacks to SignupAction values.

nodes.name: CredentialBorderedTextField
nodes.summary: Shared wrapper over BorderedTextField that applies the keyboard type, capitalization, autocorrect, focus handling, autofocus, and the Go IME action for credential input.

nodes.name: EmailTextField
nodes.summary: Email credential input with the email keyboard and no autocorrect. On Go it clears focus, then submits or shows the email validation snackbar.

nodes.name: PhoneTextField
nodes.summary: Phone credential input with the phone keyboard. On Go it clears focus, then submits or shows the phone number validation snackbar.

nodes.name: EmailCredentialButton
nodes.summary: Public toggle button that selects the email credential type and carries the EMAIL_CREDENTIAL_BUTTON tag for end-to-end tests.

nodes.name: PhoneCredentialButton
nodes.summary: Public toggle button that selects the phone credential type and carries the PHONE_CREDENTIAL_BUTTON tag for end-to-end tests.

nodes.name: ViewWebMapText
nodes.summary: Underlined clickable text that links to the live web map. It renders only when its visibility flag, the internet availability, is true.

nodes.name: CredentialButton
nodes.summary: Generic credential toggle built on TreeTrackerButton that shows as selected when the current credential is an instance of the given Credential class.

nodes.name: ExistingUserDialog
nodes.summary: CustomDialog that tells the grower the credential already belongs to a user and offers that user as a selectable UserButton.

nodes.name: NameEntryView.kt
nodes.summary: Second signup step where the grower types a first and a last name in bordered text fields with inline validation errors. Next is enabled only for a valid form and launches the selfie camera.

nodes.name: NameEntryView
nodes.summary: Name entry composable with the logo and language button on top, first and last name fields whose IME action moves focus down or launches the camera, and an error caption under each field.

nodes.name: SignUpScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Signup flow entry that switches between the credential step and the name step and handles the selfie camera result. After the user is created, it opens the Dashboard for a power user or continues capture setup for a new grower.

nodes.name: navigateToDashboardAfterSignup
nodes.summary: Navigates to the Dashboard and clears the whole back stack, so back from the Dashboard exits the app whichever route led to signup (first run, logout, or profile deletion).

nodes.name: SignUpScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful signup host that launches CaptureImageContract for the selfie, creates the user from the photo path, and routes an existing-user choice to power-user setup or to the capture setup flow.

nodes.name: SignUp
nodes.summary: Stateless switch that shows CredentialEntryView or NameEntryView from the isCredentialView flag in SignUpState.

nodes.name: SplashScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Launch screen that requests camera, location, activity recognition, and notification permissions, bootstraps the app, and then routes to language selection for first-time setup or to the Dashboard.

nodes.name: SplashScreen
nodes.summary: Requests the runtime permission set for the device API level. After any answer it bootstraps the view model, waits one second, and navigates; GPS updates for signup start only when both location permissions were granted.

nodes.name: Splash
nodes.summary: Draws the splash image full screen, or a gray box when the splash drawable cannot be resolved at runtime, with the SPLASH test tag in both cases.

nodes.name: isLocationPermissionGranted
nodes.summary: Returns true only when both the fine and the coarse location permissions are granted in the permission result map.

nodes.name: navigateToLanguageScreen
nodes.summary: Opens the language picker for a first run and removes the splash route from the back stack.

nodes.name: navigateToDashboardScreen
nodes.summary: Opens the Dashboard on a device that is already set up and removes the splash route from the back stack.

nodes.name: CustomTheme.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the custom text color and typography tokens as static CompositionLocals, and the CustomTheme composable that provides Montserrat-based text styles and brand colors to the UI tree.
nodes.languageNotes: A Kotlin object and a composable function share the name CustomTheme: the object reads tokens (CustomTheme.typography), the function provides them (CustomTheme { ... }).

nodes.name: CustomTextColors
nodes.summary: Immutable data class with four text color tokens: light text, dark text, primary brand green text, and upload orange text.

nodes.name: CustomTypography
nodes.summary: Immutable data class with the small, regular, medium, and large TextStyle tokens of the app.

nodes.name: CustomTheme
nodes.summary: Accessor object whose composable getters read the current text colors and typography from LocalCustomColors and LocalCustomTypography.

nodes.name: CustomTheme
nodes.summary: Theme provider composable that builds the Montserrat font family, the concrete color values, and 12, 14, 16, and 24 sp text styles, then provides them to its content. Its textColors and typography parameters are shadowed by local values.

nodes.name: TreeDetailScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Tree detail screen for a captured tree. It shows the photo or a placeholder, the UUID, coordinates, creation time, and upload state, and lets the grower edit the note or delete the tree while it is not yet uploaded.

nodes.name: TreeDetailScreen
nodes.summary: Creates TreeDetailViewModel for the given tree ID through its factory, subscribes to UI events, and forwards actions to the stateless TreeDetail.

nodes.name: TreeDetail
nodes.summary: Stateless tree detail layout with read-only fields, an outlined note editor that is disabled after upload, save and delete buttons for unsynced trees, and a delete confirmation CustomDialog.

nodes.name: DetailField
nodes.summary: Private label and value pair in small gray and regular white text, with the test tag on the value text.

nodes.name: TreeEditUserSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Settings path entry that reuses UserSelect to choose the grower whose trees will be edited, with user creation and notifications turned off, and then opens the tree list for that wallet.

nodes.name: TreeEditUserSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Configures UserSelect in settings mode with green colors and navigates to TreeListRoute with the chosen user's wallet and full name.

nodes.name: TreeListScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Two-column grid of the trees a grower captured, for editing. It has an empty-state illustration, single selection, and a Next arrow that opens the detail screen of the selected tree.

nodes.name: TreeListScreen
nodes.summary: Obtains TreeListViewModel for the wallet, forwards tree selection actions, and wires throttled back and detail navigation.

nodes.name: TreeList
nodes.summary: Stateless tree list layout with the user name and subtitle in the top bar and either an empty message, when loading ended with no trees, or a LazyVerticalGrid of TreeButton items.

nodes.name: TreeButton
nodes.summary: Selectable tree card built on SelectableImageDetail that shows the tree photo, the capture date, and up to two lines of the note.

nodes.name: TreeHeightColourSelection.kt
nodes.summary: Capture flow step where the grower records tree height by choosing a colour from a list of animated buttons. Next continues the capture flow after a colour is selected.

nodes.name: treeHeightColorTag
nodes.summary: Internal helper that builds the test tag of the colour button at a given index, so UI tests can address each colour option.

nodes.name: TreeHeightScreen
nodes.summary: Collects TreeHeightSelectionViewModel state, handles UI events, and moves the capture flow forward through CaptureFlowScopeManager when a colour is selected.

nodes.name: TreeHeight
nodes.summary: Stateless list of colour buttons that animate to a larger size when selected, under an uppercase title, with a Next arrow enabled only after a choice.

nodes.name: UserSelect.kt
nodes.summary: Shared planter picker used by several flows: a grid of user cards with selection, an optional add-user button, and back and next arrows whose behavior depends on whether the picker opened from settings.

nodes.name: UserSelect
nodes.summary: Stateful planter picker wrapper that loads users, ignores the second tap of a double tap before it opens signup, and goes back to the Dashboard or pops the stack when it opened from settings.

nodes.name: UserSelectContent
nodes.summary: Stateless two-column grid of UserButton items with unread-message badges when enabled, an optional orange add button, and arrows that forward only the selected user.

nodes.name: PreviewDependencies.kt
nodes.summary: Wrapper for Compose previews that provides a stub Navigator at the splash route plus the custom and app themes, so screens that read LocalNavigator can render in previews.

nodes.name: PreviewDependencies
nodes.summary: Remembers a Navigator over a one-item back stack, provides it as LocalNavigator, and wraps the content in CustomTheme and TreeTrackerTheme.

nodes.name: ActionBar.kt
nodes.summary: Reusable 80dp bar with three equal-weight slots for left, center, and right composable actions. Most screens use it as their top bar and bottom bar.

nodes.name: ActionBar
nodes.summary: Row composable that puts three BoxScope slot lambdas in equal-weight boxes, with 4dp padding and a fixed 80dp height.

nodes.name: BorderedTextField.kt
nodes.summary: Shared text input with a thin white rounded border, a transparent indicator, a focus requester, focus callbacks, optional autofocus on first composition, and an optional test tag.

nodes.name: BorderedTextField
nodes.summary: Wraps a Material TextField in a bordered Box, applies the app colors, forwards keyboard options and actions, and requests focus once when autofocus is enabled.

nodes.name: DepthButtonColors.kt
nodes.summary: ButtonColors implementation for the raised depth buttons of the app. It holds a shadow color and a face color for the enabled and disabled states, with hand-written equality.

nodes.name: DepthButtonColors
nodes.summary: Immutable ButtonColors where backgroundColor gives the shadow color and contentColor gives the face color for the enabled state. Value-based equals and hashCode make instances compare by their four colors.

nodes.name: NoMessages.kt
nodes.summary: Empty-state composable for message lists that shows an open mailbox illustration and a localized 'no messages yet' caption.

nodes.name: NoMessages
nodes.summary: Centered column with the mailbox drawable and a large bold caption, tagged NO_MESSAGES for UI tests.

nodes.name: ProfileField.kt
nodes.summary: Labeled profile value that renders a BorderedTextField when editable or large read-only text otherwise, for the grower profile screen.

nodes.name: ProfileField
nodes.summary: Column with a medium label and, from the editable flag, an editable bordered field or plain text; both carry the optional test tag.

nodes.name: SnackBar.kt
nodes.summary: App-styled snackbar host that renders messages in the custom typography on a configurable background, green by default, with an optional action button.

nodes.name: CustomSnackbar
nodes.summary: SnackbarHost whose snackbar uses the given background color, the SNACKBAR test tag, dark text, and an action label button that calls onDismiss.

nodes.name: TestTags.kt
nodes.summary: Central registry of Compose test tags for end-to-end and UI tests, grouped by screen, plus a modifier that exposes test tags as resource IDs to accessibility-tree tools such as Maestro and UiAutomator.

nodes.name: exposeTestTags
nodes.summary: Modifier extension that sets testTagsAsResourceId in semantics. It is applied once on each composition root, including each dialog window.

nodes.name: TestTags
nodes.summary: Object of unique tag constants for shared UI, dialogs, signup, dashboard, capture, settings, profile, tree edit, map, messages, and dev options, plus per-item tag builders such as userButton and treeButton.

nodes.name: Text.kt
nodes.summary: Holds the shared DarkText style and the TopBarTitle logo composable, whose long press opens developer options in debug or beta builds.

nodes.name: TextStyles
nodes.summary: Object that exposes the DarkText TextStyle: 24 sp bold text in the gray shadow color.

nodes.name: TopBarTitle
nodes.summary: BoxScope composable that centers the Greenstand logo with a test tag. When the debug or beta flag is on, a long press navigates to DevOptionsRoute.

nodes.name: Tutorial.kt
nodes.summary: Tutorial dialogs that teach the grower how to take a selfie, capture a tree, and review a capture. They use illustrations and inert copies of the real capture, note, and approval buttons.

nodes.name: SelfieTutorial
nodes.summary: Tutorial dialog that shows the capture button and the selfie illustration with the selfie instruction text.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureTutorial
nodes.summary: Tutorial dialog that shows the capture button and the tree capturing illustration with the tracking instruction text.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureReviewTutorial
nodes.summary: Tutorial dialog that wraps the TreeCaptureReview content, which explains the note, approve, and recapture buttons.

nodes.name: ImageCapturing
nodes.summary: Column with a 'click on' label, a disabled capture button hidden from accessibility, the instruction text, and an illustration image.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureReview
nodes.summary: Three rows that pair explanatory text with inert note, approve, and reject buttons and a touch gesture image; all buttons are cleared from semantics.

nodes.name: TutorialDialog
nodes.summary: Semi-transparent AlertDialog with a green rounded border that exposes test tags for its own window and closes with an approval button tagged TUTORIAL_DONE_BUTTON.

nodes.name: UserImageButton.kt
nodes.summary: Square image button that shows a locally stored user photo inside a TreeTrackerButton, with a public test tag constant for UI tests.

nodes.name: UserImageButton
nodes.summary: BoxScope composable that centers a 100dp rounded TreeTrackerButton with a cropped LocalImage loaded from the given path.

nodes.name: CustomDialog.kt
nodes.summary: General-purpose alert dialog of the app with an icon and title row, an optional message, an optional text input, a custom content slot, and approve or reject buttons that appear only when their callbacks are set.

nodes.name: CustomDialog
nodes.summary: AlertDialog with a green rounded border that exposes test tags for its window, tags its title, message, text field, and buttons, and renders each optional part only when it is provided.

nodes.name: GpsDialog.kt
nodes.summary: Dialog for a device without GPS hardware, built on CustomDialog with an error icon and a single confirm button.

nodes.name: NoGPSDeviceDialog
nodes.summary: Calls CustomDialog with the error outline icon, the no-GPS header and message strings, and the given positive click callback.

nodes.name: PrivacyPolicyDialog.kt
nodes.summary: Full-screen overlay panel that shows the privacy policy text in a scrollable area, with a logo header and an approval button that closes it.

nodes.name: PrivacyPolicyDialog
nodes.summary: Bordered gray column weighted into a header, scrollable policy text, and a close ApprovalButton tagged PRIVACY_POLICY_CLOSE_BUTTON that calls onDismiss.

nodes.name: HandleUIEvents.kt
nodes.summary: Composable bridge that collects one-shot UiEvents from a BaseViewModel and performs navigation, back navigation, or snackbars. It ignores navigation events from screens that are no longer on top of the back stack.

nodes.name: HandleUIEvents
nodes.summary: LaunchedEffect that consumes each event once, lets an optional onEvent hook intercept it, runs NavigationEvent and PopBackStackEvent only for the top entry, and forwards ShowSnackbar to SnackbarController.

nodes.name: isHostingEntryOnTop
nodes.summary: Returns true when the composition is not inside a nav entry, or when its entry content key equals the string form of the navigator's top key.

nodes.name: SnackbarController.kt
nodes.summary: App-wide snackbar bus: a SharedFlow of ShowSnackbar events with a CompositionLocal accessor that fails fast when Root has not provided it.

nodes.name: SnackbarController
nodes.summary: Class with a buffered MutableSharedFlow of ShowSnackbar events, exposed read-only, and a show method that emits without suspending.

nodes.name: TextRef.kt
nodes.summary: Context-free text reference that view models emit as a plain string or as a string resource with arguments, with helpers that resolve it from a Context or inside a composable.
nodes.languageNotes: A sealed interface with a companion operator invoke lets call sites construct it like a constructor: TextRef(R.string.x) or TextRef("text").

nodes.name: TextRef
nodes.summary: Sealed interface with Plain and Res data classes and companion invoke builders, so view models can hold user-facing text without a Context.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Context extension that turns a TextRef into a String with getString, and passes the format arguments when there are any.

nodes.name: asString
nodes.summary: Composable extension that resolves a TextRef with stringResource, so the text follows configuration changes such as the locale.

nodes.name: UiEvents.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the one-shot UI event model for view models: the UiEvent marker, built-in navigation, pop-back, and snackbar events, and a wrapper that lets a replayed event be consumed only once.

nodes.name: UiEvent
nodes.summary: Marker interface for one-shot events that view models emit; feature-specific events implement it and are handled through the onEvent hook.

nodes.name: NavigationEvent
nodes.summary: Event that carries a suspend lambda on Navigator so a view model can request any navigation. It is a plain class because lambda fields break data class equality.

nodes.name: PopBackStackEvent
nodes.summary: Data object event that asks the screen to pop the back stack one step through throttled navigation.

nodes.name: ShowSnackbar
nodes.summary: Data class event with a TextRef message, a duration that defaults to short, an optional TextRef action label, and an optional action callback.

nodes.name: ConsumableEvent
nodes.summary: Generic wrapper that uses an AtomicBoolean so getContentIfNotConsumed returns the event only on the first call, which stops a replay from firing it twice.

nodes.name: AddWalletScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Capture setup screen where the grower types a new wallet name. Next is enabled for a non-blank name and is blocked while a restored setup misses its user or on the second tap of a double tap.

nodes.name: AddWalletScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful wrapper that runs LeaveLostSetupEffect and routes Back and Next through CaptureSetupScopeManager, and drops Next during a restore or on the second tap of a double tap.

nodes.name: AddWallet
nodes.summary: Stateless add wallet layout with arrow buttons and a BorderedTextField for the wallet name without capitalization, where keyboard Go also sends NavigateNext.

nodes.name: SurveyViewModelTest.kt
nodes.summary: Unit tests for SurveyViewModel with MockK, Turbine, and coroutine test rules. They cover the survey and user loading order, answer selection and restoration across questions, saving answers on finish, and the snackbar and pop-back events.

nodes.name: SurveyViewModelTest
nodes.summary: JUnit test class with mocked MessagesRepo and UserRepo, fake survey fixtures, and helpers that build a three-question survey view model and read its replayed events.

nodes.name: setup
nodes.summary: Stubs the repositories to return the fake survey message and the first fake user, then creates the view model under test.

nodes.languageNotes: Kotlin Strings are immutable: String.replace returns a new string, so a call whose result is not used has no effect.

nodes.summary: Kotlin singleton object that groups the email and phone number validators used for grower credential input.

nodes.name: isEmailValid

nodes.name: FakeNavigator.kt
nodes.summary: Test utility that builds a real Navigator over an in-memory back stack with a manually advanced FakeClock. ViewModel tests use it to run captured NavigationEvent lambdas and to make the navigation throttle deterministic.

nodes.name: FakeClock
nodes.summary: Mutable clock for tests whose current time in milliseconds only changes when a test calls advance, so throttle windows can be crossed on demand.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: Moves the fake clock forward by the given number of milliseconds.

nodes.name: fakeNavigator
nodes.summary: Factory that creates a Navigator over a mutable list seeded with the given NavKey entries and reads the time from a FakeClock.

nodes.name: TestViewModel.kt
nodes.summary: Test fixtures for the viewmodel layer: a minimal TestState, a TestAction sealed interface, a custom TestEvent, and a TestViewModel that exposes the protected BaseViewModel helpers so tests can update state, send events, and navigate.

nodes.name: TestState
nodes.summary: Data class with a count and a label that serves as the state type of TestViewModel.

nodes.name: TestAction
nodes.summary: Sealed action interface for TestViewModel with an Increment data object and a Rename data class that carries a new label.

nodes.name: TestEvent
nodes.summary: Custom UiEvent data class with an integer id, used to test how HandleUIEvents treats feature-specific events.

nodes.name: TestViewModel
nodes.summary: Minimal BaseViewModel subclass over TestState and TestAction whose public wrappers call the protected state, event, and navigation helpers.

nodes.name: handleAction
nodes.summary: Applies a TestAction by incrementing the count or replacing the label through updateState.

nodes.name: readCurrentState
nodes.summary: Returns the protected currentState snapshot so that tests can assert on it.

nodes.name: emit
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that sends a UiEvent through the protected sendEvent helper.

nodes.name: emitViaTrigger
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that sends a UiEvent through the protected triggerEvent helper, which is the alternative event path.

nodes.name: navigateTo
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that queues navigation to a NavKey route through the base navigate helper.

nodes.name: navigateWithOptions
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that queues navigation to a route with a NavOptions builder, for example popUpTo or launchSingleTop.

nodes.name: goBack
nodes.summary: Public wrapper that queues a pop-back-stack event through the base popBackStack helper.

nodes.name: ExceptionLogger.kt
nodes.summary: Timber tree for release builds that forwards warning-and-above log calls to Firebase Crashlytics as recorded exceptions, so production errors reach crash reporting.

nodes.name: ExceptionLogger
nodes.summary: Timber.Tree subclass that the application plants when debug mode is off; it turns non-verbose, non-debug log events into Crashlytics exception records.

nodes.name: log
nodes.summary: Drops VERBOSE and DEBUG priorities, wraps a message that has no throwable in a new Exception, and records the result with Firebase Crashlytics.

nodes.name: ObjectStorageClient.kt
nodes.summary: AWS S3 SDK wrapper that authenticates through a Cognito identity pool and stores capture images and JSON upload bundles in object storage buckets; every uploader in the sync flow sends its data through it.
nodes.languageNotes: The private constructor plus companion init/instance pair is a manual singleton, an alternative to declaring a Kotlin object when construction needs a Context.

nodes.name: ObjectStorageClient
nodes.summary: Process-wide singleton (set up by init, read through instance) that builds an AmazonS3Client either for an AWS S3 region or for a custom S3-compatible endpoint, depending on BuildConfig.USE_AWS_S3.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Uploads a local image file to the images bucket under a key built from a timestamp, the capture coordinates, a random UUID, and the file name, then returns the object URL in the AWS or custom-endpoint format.

nodes.name: uploadBundle
nodes.summary: Writes a serialized JSON upload bundle as UTF-8 bytes to the batch-uploads bucket, keyed by timestamp, random UUID, and bundle id, with an explicit content length.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Companion initializer that constructs the single ObjectStorageClient from the application context; TreeTrackerApplication calls it at startup.

nodes.name: instance
nodes.summary: Companion accessor that returns the initialized ObjectStorageClient and fails with a null assertion when init has not run yet.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigRequest.kt
nodes.summary: Serializable payload that describes one device configuration record (app version and build, OS and SDK levels, hardware model fields, instance id, logged time) for V2 upload bundles.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigRequest
nodes.summary: kotlinx.serialization class with snake_case field names whose manufacturer, brand, model, hardware, and device fields default from android.os.Build and whose device identifier defaults from DeviceUtils.

nodes.name: DeviceRequest.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy V1 device descriptor payload that captures app version, build number, Android release, SDK level, and hardware fields straight from BuildConfig and android.os.Build.

nodes.name: DeviceRequest
nodes.summary: Data class whose properties keep their raw snake_case and camelCase names without SerialName overrides; UploadBundle.createV1 attaches one instance per bundle with only the instance id supplied.

nodes.name: NewTreeRequest.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy V1 tree capture payload plus its key-value attribute type, serialized into the trees list of version 1 upload bundles.

nodes.name: NewTreeRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class for a legacy tree record with planter id, UUID, coordinates, GPS accuracy, note, timestamp, image URL, sequence id, planter photo, and an optional attribute list; every field has a default.

nodes.name: AttributeRequest
nodes.summary: Small serializable key/value pair that carries one extra tree attribute inside NewTreeRequest.attributes.

nodes.name: RegistrationRequest.kt
nodes.summary: Legacy V1 planter registration payload with name, organization, contact fields, coordinates, record UUID, and registration photo URL.

nodes.name: RegistrationRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class that PlanterUploader fills from PlanterInfo rows; the device identifier defaults from DeviceUtils and the image URL points to the planter's earliest check-in photo.

nodes.name: SessionRequest.kt
nodes.summary: V2 session payload that links a capture session to its originating wallet registration, target wallet, organization, and device configuration.

nodes.name: SessionRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class that maps sessionId to id, originUserId to originating_wallet_registration_id, and deviceConfigId to device_configuration_id for the sessions list of a V2 bundle.

nodes.name: TracksRequest.kt
nodes.summary: Location track payload types: a session id with a list of GPS fixes, where each fix carries accuracy, capture time, latitude, and longitude.

nodes.name: TracksRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class that groups the GPS location samples recorded during one capture session for the tracks list of a V2 bundle.

nodes.name: LocationRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class for a single GPS fix with accuracy, a capturedAt timestamp string, latitude, and longitude.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureRequest.kt
nodes.summary: V2 tree capture payload for upload bundles, with session id, tree id, coordinates, note, image URL, capture time, step counts, rotation matrix, and extra attributes.

nodes.name: TreeCaptureRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable class that TreeUploader builds for each TreeEntity; the step count, rotation matrix, and extra attribute fields are optional and the uploader currently sends them as null.

nodes.name: UploadBundle.kt
nodes.summary: Top-level JSON envelope for batch uploads that holds either version 1 lists (trees, registrations, devices) or version 2 lists (wallet registrations, captures, device configurations, sessions, tracks, messages).
nodes.languageNotes: Companion object functions act as named constructors, one per bundle format version, so callers never set the version string by hand.

nodes.name: UploadBundle
nodes.summary: Serializable container keyed by pack_format_version and device_id whose nullable list fields carry each request type; companion factories choose the field set for each format version.

nodes.name: createV1
nodes.summary: Builds a version 1 bundle from legacy tree and registration requests and appends a single DeviceRequest made from the given instance id.

nodes.name: createV2
nodes.summary: Builds a version 2 bundle from any mix of wallet registrations, tree captures, sessions, tracks, device configurations, and messages, and leaves the unused lists null.

nodes.name: WalletRegistrationRequest.kt
nodes.summary: V2 grower wallet registration payload with registration id, wallet handle, profile photo URL, names, optional phone and email, coordinates, and registration time.

nodes.name: WalletRegistrationRequest
nodes.summary: Serializable data class that PlanterUploader.uploadUsers creates from each pending user row, mapping imageUrl to user_photo_url and createdAt to registered_at.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerApplication.kt
nodes.summary: Android Application entry point that initializes Firebase, the object storage client, and the Koin dependency graph, and plants a debug or Crashlytics Timber tree based on the debug feature flag.

nodes.name: TreeTrackerApplication
nodes.summary: Application subclass that exposes a static appContext through its companion and performs all process-wide setup before any screen starts.

nodes.name: onCreate
nodes.summary: Stores the application context, starts Firebase and ObjectStorageClient, starts Koin with the app, room, and network modules, and then chooses between Timber.DebugTree and ExceptionLogger.

nodes.name: attachBaseContext
nodes.summary: Overrides the base context hook to install MultiDex, so that the app can load classes from more than one dex file on older Android versions.

nodes.name: Converters.kt
nodes.summary: Room type converters that store string maps and string lists as JSON text and kotlinx.datetime Instants as ISO strings, and that log and return null when a stored value cannot be decoded.

nodes.name: Converters
nodes.summary: Kotlin object that holds a lenient Json instance (ignoreUnknownKeys) and the six @TypeConverter functions Room uses for map, list, and Instant columns; MessageDatabase registers it too.

nodes.name: jsonToMap
nodes.summary: Decodes a stored JSON string into a Map<String, String>, and returns null for a null column or after it logs a decode failure.

nodes.name: mapToJson
nodes.summary: Encodes a nullable string map into JSON text for storage in a single Room column.

nodes.name: instantToString
nodes.summary: Converts a nullable kotlinx.datetime Instant into its ISO-8601 string form for a Room column.

nodes.name: stringToInstance
nodes.summary: Parses a stored ISO string back into an Instant, and logs the bad value and returns null when parsing fails.

nodes.name: stringToArray
nodes.summary: Decodes a stored JSON array string into a List<String>, and logs and returns null on malformed input.

nodes.name: arrayToString
nodes.summary: Encodes a nullable list of strings into JSON array text so that Room can persist the list in one column.

nodes.name: NetworkModule.kt
nodes.summary: Koin module that provides the singleton Retrofit instance built by RetrofitBuilder and the MessagesApiService that Retrofit creates from it.
nodes.languageNotes: Koin's get<Retrofit>() resolves the Retrofit singleton declared just above it in the same module.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigUploader.kt
nodes.summary: Sync step that collects device configuration rows that wait for upload, packs them into a V2 bundle, sends the bundle to object storage, and marks the rows as uploaded.

nodes.name: DeviceConfigUploader
nodes.summary: Uploader with TreeTrackerDAO, ObjectStorageClient, and Json dependencies that turns stored device configuration records into DeviceConfigRequest payloads.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.summary: Returns early when nothing is pending; otherwise maps each config to a DeviceConfigRequest, names the bundle by its MD5 hash plus a _deviceConfigs suffix, records the bundle id, uploads, and flags the configs as uploaded.

nodes.name: PlanterUploader.kt
nodes.summary: Uploads grower data during sync: legacy planter check-in photos, user profile photos, legacy V1 planter registrations, and V2 wallet registrations, and then deletes local check-in photos that already have remote URLs.

nodes.name: PlanterUploader
nodes.summary: Coordinator that runs the grower upload steps in order on Dispatchers.IO, with UploadImageUseCase for photos and ObjectStorageClient for JSON bundles.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.summary: Public sync entry that runs, on the IO dispatcher, legacy check-in photo upload, user photo upload, planter info upload, wallet registration upload, and local photo cleanup in sequence.

nodes.name: uploadLegacyPlanterImages
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel each pending planter check-in photo that has a local path but no URL, and saves the returned URL on the check-in row.

nodes.name: uploadUserImages
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the profile photos of pending users that have no photo URL yet, and stores each returned URL on the user row.

nodes.name: uploadPlanterInfo
nodes.summary: Builds legacy RegistrationRequest payloads for pending PlanterInfo rows with each planter's earliest check-in photo, then uploads a V1 bundle and marks the rows uploaded.

nodes.name: uploadUsers
nodes.summary: Converts pending users into WalletRegistrationRequest payloads, uploads them as a V2 bundle with a _registrations suffix, and updates their bundle ids and upload status.

nodes.name: deleteLocalImagesThatWereUploaded
nodes.summary: Deletes the local photo files of check-ins that already have a remote photo URL and then clears their stored local paths.

nodes.name: SessionUploader.kt
nodes.summary: Sync step that converts pending capture sessions into SessionRequest payloads, uploads them as a V2 bundle, and marks the sessions as uploaded.

nodes.name: SessionUploader
nodes.summary: Uploader with TreeTrackerDAO, ObjectStorageClient, and Json dependencies that publishes capture session metadata to object storage.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.summary: Resolves the device configuration UUID of each session, encodes the sessions into a V2 bundle named by MD5 plus _sessions, records the bundle id, uploads it, and marks the sessions uploaded.

nodes.name: TreeUploader.kt
nodes.summary: Uploads tree captures in windows of 50: it uploads missing tree photos, builds legacy V1 or V2 capture bundles, sends them to object storage, and deletes local photo files when a window completes.
nodes.languageNotes: Structured concurrency: coroutineScope with async/await gives parallel photo uploads, and CancellationException is rethrown so that a cancelled sync is not swallowed by the generic catch.

nodes.name: TreeUploader
nodes.summary: Uploader with image upload, tree request, DAO, storage, and Json dependencies that supports both the legacy TreeCaptureEntity table and the current TreeEntity table.

nodes.name: uploadLegacyTrees
nodes.summary: Processes legacy tree capture ids window by window: uploads photos, sends a V1 bundle, deletes local images, and clears their stored paths.

nodes.name: uploadTrees
nodes.summary: Processes current tree ids window by window: uploads photos, sends a V2 captures bundle, deletes local images, and clears their stored paths.

nodes.name: windowedTreeUpload
nodes.summary: Splits tree ids into windows of TREE_BUNDLE_SIZE and runs the handler for each window while the coroutine is active; it rethrows cancellation and logs other failures so that later windows still run.

nodes.name: uploadLegacyTreeImages
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the photos of legacy tree captures without a URL, fails the window when no URL comes back, and saves each URL on the capture row.

nodes.name: uploadTreeImages
nodes.summary: Uploads in parallel the photos of current TreeEntity rows without a URL, fails the window when no URL comes back, and saves each URL with dao.updateTree.

nodes.name: uploadLegacyTreeBundles
nodes.summary: Creates NewTreeRequest payloads through CreateTreeRequestUseCase, uploads them as a V1 bundle named by its MD5 hash, and updates the bundle id and upload flag of the legacy rows.

nodes.name: uploadTreeBundles
nodes.summary: Builds TreeCaptureRequest payloads with the session UUID of each tree, uploads them as a V2 bundle with a _captures suffix, and updates bundle ids and upload status.

nodes.name: deleteLocalImages
nodes.summary: Deletes each non-null local photo file that still exists on disk after its tree data was uploaded.

nodes.name: MessageUploader.kt
nodes.summary: Uploads outgoing chat messages and survey responses in groups of 50 by converting MessageEntity rows to MessageRequest payloads inside V2 bundles.

nodes.name: MessageUploader
nodes.summary: Uploader with ObjectStorageClient, MessagesDAO, and Json dependencies that MessagesRepo calls at the end of a message sync.

nodes.name: uploadMessages
nodes.summary: Reads the ids of messages flagged for upload, windows them in groups of LIMIT, and uploads each group concurrently.

nodes.name: uploadMessageBundle
nodes.summary: Loads a group of messages, converts them with DatabaseConverters, uploads a V2 bundle named by MD5 plus _messages, and marks the messages as uploaded.

nodes.name: MessagesRepo.kt
nodes.summary: Repository for in-app messaging that stores outgoing messages and survey answers, exposes message flows per wallet, pulls new messages from the messaging API page by page, and triggers upload of pending messages.
nodes.languageNotes: Paging uses async/awaitAll inside withContext(Dispatchers.IO); the loop copies offset into a local val before launching each async block so that every coroutine captures its own page offset.

nodes.name: MessagesRepo
nodes.summary: Repository that combines MessagesApiService, UserRepo, TimeProvider, MessagesDAO, and MessageUploader; view models and the sync use case go through it for all message reads and writes.

nodes.name: markMessageAsRead
nodes.summary: Marks one message as read by passing a single-item id list to the DAO update.

nodes.name: markMessagesAsRead
nodes.summary: Marks a whole list of message ids as read with one DAO update call.

nodes.name: saveMessage
nodes.summary: Stores a new outgoing direct message for a wallet with a random UUID and the current time, flagged for upload and already marked read.

nodes.name: saveSurveyAnswers
nodes.summary: Saves a survey response message that answers a received survey, links it to the same survey id, and marks the original survey message complete.

nodes.name: getMessageFlow
nodes.summary: Returns a Flow of all messages for a wallet and converts each stored entity into its domain Message subtype.

nodes.name: getDirectMessages
nodes.summary: Returns a Flow of the direct messages exchanged between a wallet and one other chat participant, newest first.

nodes.name: getAnnouncementMessages
nodes.summary: Loads one message by id and casts its domain form to AnnouncementMessage for the announcement screen.

nodes.name: getSurveyMessage
nodes.summary: Loads one message by id and casts its domain form to SurveyMessage for the survey screen.

nodes.name: syncMessages
nodes.summary: Fetches new server messages for the wallet of each local user, skips wallets whose 404 means they have no messages, and then uploads pending outgoing messages.

nodes.name: fetchMessagesForWallet
nodes.summary: Fetches the first page of messages since the last sync time of a wallet, then requests the remaining pages concurrently with async until the server total is covered.

nodes.name: fetchMessagesFromServerAndSaveInDb
nodes.summary: Calls the messaging API for one page and saves every returned message in parallel through saveMessageResponse.

nodes.name: saveMessageResponse
nodes.summary: Converts one server message into a MessageEntity and inserts it (survey responses are ignored), and stores its survey and questions the first time that survey appears.

nodes.name: convertMessageEntityToMessage
nodes.summary: Looks up the survey and questions linked to a message entity, when present, and builds the matching domain Message through DatabaseConverters.

nodes.name: getLastSyncTime
nodes.summary: Returns the newest composed_at timestamp stored for a wallet, or the Unix epoch when the wallet has no messages.

nodes.name: checkForUnreadMessages
nodes.summary: Returns true when at least one stored message, across all wallets, is still unread.

nodes.name: DatabaseConverters.kt
nodes.summary: Mapping helpers between the messaging Room entities, outgoing MessageRequest payloads, and the domain Message types (direct, announcement, survey, survey response).
nodes.languageNotes: Exhaustive when expressions over the MessageType enum make the compiler flag any new message type that lacks a mapping.

nodes.name: DatabaseConverters
nodes.summary: Stateless Kotlin object whose two functions switch on MessageType to translate stored message rows into request objects or domain objects.

nodes.name: createMessageRequestFromEntities
nodes.summary: Builds a MessageRequest for an outgoing MESSAGE or SURVEY_RESPONSE entity and throws an error for ANNOUNCE or SURVEY types, which the app never uploads.

nodes.name: createMessageFromEntities
nodes.summary: Builds a DirectMessage, AnnouncementMessage, SurveyMessage, or SurveyResponseMessage from a message entity plus its optional survey and question entities.

nodes.name: MessageDatabase.kt
nodes.summary: Separate Room database file (treetracker.messages.db, schema version 1) that holds the messages, surveys, and questions tables and reuses the shared Converters for list columns.

nodes.name: MessageDatabase
nodes.summary: Abstract RoomDatabase that declares MessageEntity, SurveyEntity, and QuestionEntity, exports its schema, and exposes MessagesDAO.

nodes.name: messagesDao
nodes.summary: Abstract accessor that Room generates code for; it returns the MessagesDAO bound to this database.

nodes.name: getInstance
nodes.summary: Companion factory that lazily builds the database with Room.databaseBuilder inside a synchronized block and returns the cached instance afterwards.

nodes.name: MessagesDAO.kt
nodes.summary: Room DAO interface with the SQL queries for the messages, surveys, and questions tables: inserts, deletes, wallet-scoped reads and flows, upload bookkeeping, and read-state updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Room generates the implementation; suspend functions run off the main thread, and Flow return types turn queries into observable streams.

nodes.name: MessagesDAO
nodes.summary: Data access interface for MessagesRepo and MessageUploader; Room generates its implementation from the @Query and @Insert annotations.

nodes.name: deleteMessage
nodes.summary: Deletes the message row whose id matches the given value.

nodes.name: insertMessage
nodes.summary: Inserts a MessageEntity, aborts on a primary key conflict, and returns the new row id.

nodes.name: getMessage
nodes.summary: Selects one message by id, or returns null when no row matches.

nodes.name: getLatestSyncTimeForWallet
nodes.summary: Selects the maximum composed_at value of the messages of a wallet, which becomes the since parameter of the next fetch.

nodes.name: getMessagesForWallet
nodes.summary: Suspending query that returns every stored message for one wallet as a list.

nodes.name: getMessagesForWalletFlow
nodes.summary: Observable query that emits the full message list of a wallet whenever the table changes.

nodes.name: getDirectMessagesForWallet
nodes.summary: Observable query that emits only the MESSAGE type rows of a wallet.

nodes.name: getAnnouncementMessagesForWallet
nodes.summary: Observable query that emits only the ANNOUNCE type rows of a wallet.

nodes.name: updateMessageBundleIds
nodes.summary: Writes the given bundle id onto every message whose id is in the supplied list.

nodes.name: getMessagesToUpload
nodes.summary: Returns the full message rows that still have the should_upload flag set.

nodes.name: getMessageIdsToUpload
nodes.summary: Returns only the ids of messages that still have should_upload set, so that uploads can be windowed.

nodes.name: getMessagesByIds
nodes.summary: Loads the full message rows for a list of message ids.

nodes.name: DevPrefKeys.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the typed developer-option settings (boolean, int and float configs with defaults) and the ConfigKeys catalog of image capture and GPS convergence tuning values kept under the system-settings preference root.
nodes.languageNotes: A Kotlin sealed interface lets code that branches on Config subtypes be checked for exhaustiveness by the compiler.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: Sealed interface for a developer-option setting: every config exposes the PrefKey it is stored under and a human-readable display name.

nodes.name: BooleanConfig
nodes.summary: Data class for an on/off developer setting that carries its preference key, label and boolean default.

nodes.name: IntConfig
nodes.summary: Data class for an integer developer setting, such as image height or convergence timeout, with its key, label and int default.

nodes.name: FloatConfig
nodes.summary: Data class for a floating-point developer setting, used for the GPS standard-deviation thresholds, with key, label and float default.

nodes.name: ConfigKeys
nodes.summary: Singleton catalog of the six tunable developer settings (forced image size, capture height, convergence sample size and timeout, latitude and longitude thresholds) plus the ordered list the dev options screen displays.

nodes.name: PendingTreeStore.kt
nodes.summary: Persists the in-progress tree capture (photo taken, not yet saved) as JSON in preferences, so the capture flow can restore image review after Android kills the app in the background.
nodes.languageNotes: kotlinx.serialization with ignoreUnknownKeys keeps older stored payloads readable, and a private @Serializable mirror class decouples the stored JSON shape from the Tree model.

nodes.name: PendingTreeStore
nodes.summary: Preference-backed holder for one unsaved tree capture that serializes it to JSON on save and, when the stored data cannot be decoded, clears it and reports nothing.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Converts the tree to its serializable mirror and writes the JSON string under the pending-capture preference key.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Reads and decodes the pending tree; on any decode failure it logs, clears the bad entry and returns null rather than crashing the restored screen.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Removes the pending-capture entry from preferences; load also calls it to discard unreadable data.

nodes.name: PendingTree
nodes.summary: Private @Serializable snapshot of a tree capture (UUID as string, session, note, photo path, mean coordinates, attributes) that defines the stored JSON shape.

nodes.name: toTree
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a Tree model from the stored snapshot, parsing the UUID string and copying attributes into a mutable map.

nodes.name: toPending
nodes.summary: Private extension that maps a Tree to the serializable snapshot, flattening its capture attributes into a plain map.

nodes.name: InstallReferrerOrg.kt
nodes.summary: Reads the inviting organization from the Google Play install referrer, parsing org_id and org_name query parameters, because a deep link cannot reach a device that does not yet have the app installed.

nodes.name: OrgLink
nodes.summary: Simple value pair of organization ID and name that an install referrer can carry into the app.

nodes.name: InstallReferrerOrgProvider
nodes.summary: Reads the Play install referrer until it gets a definite answer, then marks it consumed in preferences so a later org switch is never overwritten, and returns the invited organization if present.

nodes.name: consume
nodes.summary: Suspending read on the IO dispatcher: skips if already consumed, fetches the referrer with a 3-second timeout, marks it consumed on success or on unsupported devices, and leaves it for retry when unavailable.

nodes.name: markConsumed
nodes.summary: Synchronously commits the flag that records the install referrer as already read.

nodes.name: parseOrgLink
nodes.summary: Parses a referrer string such as org_id=42&org_name=Acme%20Trees into an OrgLink by wrapping it in a placeholder URI, returning null when the org ID is missing or blank.

nodes.name: OrgOverrides.kt
nodes.summary: Defines debug-only overrides for the current organization's capture setup and capture flows: a catalog of overridable steps and features, an immutable override model that rewrites an Org's destinations, and a preference-backed store that release builds always ignore.
nodes.languageNotes: Immutable data class updates through copy() and a MutableStateFlow exposed as a read-only StateFlow give observers one source of truth.

nodes.name: OrgFlow
nodes.summary: Enum naming the two organization-configurable flows, capture setup and tree capture.

nodes.name: OrgStepOption
nodes.summary: Describes one overridable step of an org flow for the dev options screen, with its route, label and whether the navigation controllers require it.

nodes.name: OrgFeatureOption
nodes.summary: Describes one feature flag on a specific flow step that the dev options screen can override, and derives its unique override key.

nodes.name: featureKey
nodes.summary: Builds the flow|route|feature string that keys a feature override in the overrides map.

nodes.name: OrgOverrideCatalog
nodes.summary: Singleton list of every overridable setup step, capture step and step feature in canonical order, with user select and tree capture marked as required.

nodes.name: steps
nodes.summary: Returns the catalog's canonical step options for either the setup flow or the capture flow.

nodes.name: OrgOverrides
nodes.summary: Serializable debug override set with a master switch, per-flow step toggles, feature toggles and an optional wallet ID; it applies only the changed settings on top of the current Org.

nodes.name: steps
nodes.summary: Returns the stored route-to-enabled step overrides for the requested flow.

nodes.name: withStep
nodes.summary: Returns a copy with a step override set for one route of a flow, or removed when the new value is null.

nodes.name: withFeature
nodes.summary: Returns a copy in which one feature override key is set, or dropped when the value passed is null.

nodes.name: applyTo
nodes.summary: Overlays the enabled overrides onto an Org, replacing its wallet ID and rewriting both flow destination lists, or returns the Org unchanged when the master switch is off.

nodes.name: applyFlow
nodes.summary: Rewrites one flow's destinations: drops steps switched off (never required ones), inserts switched-on steps after their canonical predecessor, then applies feature overrides to each destination.

nodes.name: applyFeatures
nodes.summary: Adds or removes catalog feature keys on one destination according to the feature overrides, keeping the original object when nothing changes.

nodes.name: OrgOverrideStore
nodes.summary: Preference-backed store that exposes overrides as a StateFlow, persists each update as JSON and returns active overrides only in debug builds with the master switch on.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Applies a transform to the current overrides, publishes the result and commits it to preferences as JSON.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Resets the overrides to defaults and deletes the stored JSON entry from preferences.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Reads stored overrides at startup, returning empty overrides for release builds, missing data or unreadable JSON.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupData.kt
nodes.summary: Holds the in-memory state of one capture setup session (selected user, destination wallet, session note, organization name) and mirrors every change into ExceptionDataCollector so error reports carry the setup context.
nodes.languageNotes: Custom property setters that assign the backing field keep the reporting side effect next to the state it describes.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupData
nodes.summary: Scoped holder for the setup user, destination wallet, session note and organization name, whose setters also tag the exception-report context with each value.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupRestorer.kt
nodes.summary: Recovers capture setup after process death: reopens the in-memory setup scope that Navigation 3 cannot restore and reloads the setup user from a user ID saved in preferences.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupRestorer
nodes.summary: Helper that each setup step's view model uses to detect a restore after process death, reopen the setup scope and get the setup user back.

nodes.name: reopenIfClosed
nodes.summary: Opens the setup scope if it is closed and returns true to signal that the step was restored and its user must be reloaded.

nodes.name: loadUser
nodes.summary: Returns the setup user, reloading it from the saved ID after a restore; it cancels if the scope changed meanwhile, closes the scope when no user is found, and saves the user ID for later restores.

nodes.name: SetupScope.kt
nodes.summary: Manages a Koin scope that lives for the length of one capture setup flow, giving setup screens shared access to CaptureSetupData and the CaptureSetupNavigationController until the scope is closed.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements KoinScopeComponent with a lazily created scope, so each open() call yields fresh scoped instances.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupScopeManager
nodes.summary: Global singleton that opens, exposes and closes the single active capture setup Koin scope, failing fast when data or navigation is requested while it is closed.

nodes.name: open
nodes.summary: Creates a new setup scope, closing any already-open one with a warning, and eagerly instantiates its CaptureSetupData.

nodes.name: getData
nodes.summary: Returns the CaptureSetupData of the open scope or throws an error that tells the caller to open the scope first.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes the active Koin scope and forgets it, releasing the setup data and navigation controller.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupScope
nodes.summary: KoinScopeComponent whose lazily created scope owns the per-setup instances of data and navigation controller.

nodes.name: User.kt
nodes.summary: Defines the User data model for a grower account shown in user and wallet selection: ID, wallet, tree count, names, photo path, power-user flag and unread-message flag.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Grower account record with immutable ID, wallet and tree count, and mutable profile fields such as names, photo path and power-user status.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupNavigationController.kt
nodes.summary: Drives forward and backward navigation through the organization-configured capture setup flow, guarding against double taps, re-syncing its step index with the back stack, and starting the session, sensors and GPS before it hands over to tree capture.

nodes.name: CaptureSetupNavigationController
nodes.summary: FlowNavigationController for the org's capture setup destinations that moves between setup steps, returns to user select, continues after signup and starts a capture session when setup ends.

nodes.name: navForward
nodes.summary: Public forward action that drops repeat calls (still running, or screen no longer on top), syncs the step index with the back stack and then advances.

nodes.name: advance
nodes.summary: At the last setup step it enables the step counter and orientation, starts a session and GPS, and opens tree capture with the user photo; otherwise it navigates to the next setup destination.

nodes.name: syncIndexWithBackStack
nodes.summary: Re-derives the current step index from the topmost setup screen on the back stack, preferring the occurrence at or before the current index when a route repeats.

nodes.name: navBackward
nodes.summary: Decrements the setup step index and pops the back stack with throttling.

nodes.name: navToUserSelect
nodes.summary: Resets the step index and navigates to user select, popping up to the dashboard as a single-top destination.

nodes.name: navFromNewUserCreation
nodes.summary: Continues setup after signup creates a user: it moves past the signup step, finishes setup if signup was last, or opens the next step while popping the signup flow.

nodes.name: PrefKey.kt
nodes.summary: Defines PrefKey, a path-based preference key whose plus operator joins paths and keeps the per-user key type when the right-hand key is user-scoped.
nodes.languageNotes: Kotlin operator overloading (operator fun plus) lets keys compose as ROOT + PrefKey("session").

nodes.name: PrefKey
nodes.summary: Open preference key type wrapping a slash-separated path, composable with the plus operator and convertible to a user-scoped key.

nodes.name: plus
nodes.summary: Joins two key paths with a slash and returns a UserPrefKey when the appended key is user-scoped, otherwise a plain PrefKey.

nodes.name: asUserPref
nodes.summary: Converts this key to a UserPrefKey with the same path so its stored value becomes per user.

nodes.name: PrefKeys.kt
nodes.summary: Declares the three root preference namespaces (session, user settings, system settings) under the greenstand prefix; values under SESSION are wiped on logout.

nodes.name: PrefKeys
nodes.summary: Singleton defining the greenstand root key and the session, user-settings and system-settings namespaces built from it.

nodes.name: Preferences.kt
nodes.summary: Wraps Android SharedPreferences with PrefKey-based typed getters, a fluent Editor, per-user key resolution, session-data clearing and Flow observers that emit when a watched key changes.
nodes.languageNotes: A replaying MutableSharedFlow fed by an OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener turns preference writes into Flow streams that callers filter by key.

nodes.name: Preferences
nodes.summary: SharedPreferences facade that resolves PrefKey paths (appending the current user ID for user-scoped keys), offers typed reads and observers, and clears session keys on logout.

nodes.name: setUserId
nodes.summary: Sets the active user ID that user-scoped keys append to their storage path.

nodes.name: getBoolean
nodes.summary: Reads a boolean at the resolved key path, falling back to the default the caller must supply.

nodes.name: getString
nodes.summary: Reads a nullable string at the resolved key path, with null as the default fallback.

nodes.name: getLong
nodes.summary: Reads a long at the resolved key path, using -1 as the default when nothing is stored.

nodes.name: getFloat
nodes.summary: Reads a float at the resolved key path, returning -1f when the key is absent.

nodes.name: getInt
nodes.summary: Reads an int at the resolved key path, returning -1 when no value has been written.

nodes.name: observeInt
nodes.summary: Returns a Flow that re-reads the int value each time the change listener reports a write to that key's path.

nodes.name: observeString
nodes.summary: Returns a Flow of the string value that emits after every change to the observed key's path.

nodes.name: computePath
nodes.summary: Maps a PrefKey to its storage path, suffixing the active user ID for UserPrefKey instances.

nodes.name: clearSessionData
nodes.summary: Removes all values stored under the SESSION namespace, which happens when a user logs out.

nodes.name: clearPrefKeyUsage
nodes.summary: Deletes every stored entry whose key contains the given prefix path and applies the edit asynchronously.

nodes.name: edit
nodes.summary: Creates an Editor bound to this instance's path resolution so writes honour user-scoped keys.

nodes.name: Editor
nodes.summary: Fluent write wrapper around SharedPreferences.Editor that resolves PrefKey paths for put and remove calls and finishes with apply or commit.

nodes.name: UserPrefKey.kt
nodes.summary: Marks a PrefKey as user-scoped, so Preferences appends the active user's ID to its path and each grower gets a separate stored value.

nodes.name: UserPrefKey
nodes.summary: PrefKey subclass whose stored value is kept separately for each user by appending the active user ID to the path.

nodes.name: UserSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Compose entry screen of capture setup that shows the shared user picker with create-user and notifications turned on, resumes setup when it is shown again, and advances through the setup navigation controller.

nodes.name: UserSelectScreen
nodes.summary: Composable that wires UserSelectViewModel into the shared UserSelect UI, calls resumeSetup when shown, and launches setup navigation forward on Next.

nodes.name: SelectableItemDetail.kt
nodes.summary: Reusable Compose cards for selection grids: a generic selectable card with a photo or placeholder, a gradient selection border and slot content, plus a user card that shows name, wallet and tree count.

nodes.name: SelectableImageDetail
nodes.summary: Composable fixed-size selectable button that shows a cropped local photo or a placeholder icon, an optional header and caller content, with a gradient border when selected.

nodes.name: UserButton
nodes.summary: Composable user card built on SelectableImageDetail that shows the user's photo, full name, wallet, tree count and an optional notification icon.

nodes.name: WalletSelectScreen.kt
nodes.summary: Compose wallet selection step of capture setup that lists the current user and other planters as destination wallets, routes actions to setup navigation or the view model, and blocks leaving while a restored setup is still reloading.

nodes.name: WalletSelectScreen
